<div class="sect1">
<h2 id="_overview"><a class="link" href="#_overview">1. Overview</a></h2>
<div class="sectionbody">
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_what_is_lena"><a class="link" href="#_what_is_lena">1.1. What is LENA?</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>LENA is a web middleware solution that includes all components necessary for serving JAVA J2EE Web Applications in Enterprise environments.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>LENA consists of Server products that provide actual web services and a Web UI-based Manager Console for integrated management. Users can easily perform Server installation, Parameter configuration, and inter-product integration through the Manager Console, and with LENA’s user-friendly UX/UI design, even users unfamiliar with web middleware solutions can quickly learn how to use them and acquire web middleware-related knowledge.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>LENA provides various convenience features by consolidating years of operational know-how from web middleware operators in data center/cloud environments. Additionally, it provides Clustering with high availability and fault tolerance, and failure diagnostics/response functionality to stably process large-scale transactions and minimize service failures.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The following sections explain LENA’s features in more detail.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_lena_features"><a class="link" href="#_lena_features">1.2. LENA Features</a></h3>
<div class="dlist">
<dl>
<dt class="hdlist1">Enterprise Requirements Provision</dt>
<dd>
<p>LENA Web Application Server EE (J2EE Edition) supports J2EE specifications such as EJB, JTA/XA, JMS, JAX-WS required for executing Enterprise Web Applications. Additionally, it has achieved improvements in startup performance and Application Deploy performance compared to third-party WAS, and resource usage efficiency such as CPU/Memory has also been improved. For high availability, Session Server is provided by default in Enterprise Edition for essential Session Clustering.</p>
</dd>
<dt class="hdlist1">Open Source Compatibility Guarantee</dt>
<dd>
<p>LENA Web Server and LENA WAS are implemented on Open Source Base, ensuring perfect Open Source compatibility. Web Applications written on Open Source basis can be applied to LENA without separate modifications, greatly reducing transition effort. Additionally, using standard technologies for libraries and configuration resolves vendor dependency and strengthens users' IT ownership.</p>
</dd>
<dt class="hdlist1">Intelligent Failure Diagnostics/Response and Service Tracing</dt>
<dd>
<p>It can perform diagnostics based on pre-defined rules for representative failure situations such as Thread Pool Full / Hang / Out of memory and take appropriate measures. Based on real-time collected monitoring data, it analyzes and prevents failure situations through Fake Page bypass or forced restart before servers lead to actual failures, or minimizes failure time even if failures occur. Simultaneously, it provides related Dumps and Reports to enable cause analysis.</p>
</dd>
<dt class="hdlist1">Multi-Server Management and Centralized Operation</dt>
<dd>
<p>Multiple LENA Web Servers and LENA WAS can be grouped into a single Cluster, allowing control of multiple servers simultaneously through single operation. Stable application is possible through consistent configuration synchronization along with Graceful Restart or Rolling Restart. Additionally, Multi Control is supported for servers not grouped in clusters.</p>
</dd>
<dt class="hdlist1">Operational Differentiation Features</dt>
<dd>
<p>Provides various convenience features for easy operation of web middleware solutions. Using template-based simple and fast Server installation and Server replication features, desired configuration sets can be built in a short time. Through Topology View, configuration and integration information between Server modules can be checked at a glance, improving visibility. Through Dashboard, Events and performance status of operating systems can be checked. Additionally, through Multi Account management, menu/resource access permission settings are possible, and operator Action Tracing, configuration update information History tracking, and Restore functionality are provided.</p>
</dd>
</dl>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_lena_components_and_key_concepts"><a class="link" href="#_lena_components_and_key_concepts">1.3. LENA Components and Key Concepts</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>LENA is provided through Binary Package and includes all necessary components. Components are broadly divided into two categories.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Management Module for operating and managing LENA, including LENA Manager Console and LENA Node Agent.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Server Module responsible for actual Web Service, including LENA Web Server, LENA WAS (Web Application Server), and LENA Session Server.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The following covers detailed descriptions of each component along with key concepts.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_management_module"><a class="link" href="#_management_module">1.3.1. Management Module</a></h4>
<div class="dlist">
<dl>
<dt class="hdlist1">LENA Manager</dt>
<dd>
<p>LENA Manager is a Web Application designed to configure and control all resources/functions of LENA through Web UI. Installation and start can be performed through scripts prepared in the LENA Package. To perform Server installation/management through LENA Manager, integration with Node Agent and Advertiser must be configured.</p>
</dd>
</dl>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The following explains representative functions and concepts provided by LENA Manager. For detailed information not described below, refer to the "Operator Guide".</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Dashboard</strong><br>
Check resource status and Events of LENA Node and Server</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Server</strong><br>
Register LENA Node, install Web Server, WAS, Session Server, manage configuration, and control start/stop</p>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>System</strong><br>
Minimum unit for managing LENA Node and Server. Multiple Nodes can be registered under one System, but one Node cannot be registered in multiple Systems.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Node</strong><br>
Concept corresponding 1:1 with Node Agent. To execute commands on remote Servers from Manager, it must be done through Node Agent.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Cluster</strong><br>
Multi-Server management. Cluster configuration is only possible for Servers within one System, and one Server cannot belong to multiple Clusters.</p>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Server Cluster</strong><br>
Multiple LENA Web Servers and WAS can be managed as one group. Provides various convenience features such as configuration synchronization and integrated restart.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Resource</strong><br>
While not a Module provided by LENA, it defines specifications for resources that are closely integrated with LENA Server, using them as Resources. Resources can be set locally for each LENA WAS, but through the Resource menu, they can be set globally and commonly imported by WAS, avoiding duplicate work.</p>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Database</strong><br>
Defines physical specifications such as IP, Port, Driver of DBMS. Corresponds 1:1 with one DBMS.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Datasource</strong><br>
Specifies JNDI Name, Url, User ID/Password for configuring DB Connection Pool in LENA WAS. Multiple Datasources can be configured under one Database.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Application</strong><br>
Specifies the location and Context Path of the Application to be executed through LENA WAS.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Topology</strong><br>
Expresses the configuration status of LENA Web Server, LENA WAS, LENA Session Server, etc. installed and integrated on LENA Manager in Topology Diagram format. Through this function, simple Server installation and start/stop control are also possible.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Diagnostics</strong><br>
Equipped with resource monitoring for LENA Node and Server and various related functions.</p>
<div class="dlist">
<dl>
<dt class="hdlist1">LENA Node Agent</dt>
<dd>
<p>LENA Node Agent corresponds 1:1 with Node when registering Node in LENA Manager, is installed by default in LENA Package, and can be started through prepared scripts. Main roles are handling commands for Servers under Node when executing commands through LENA Manager, and also performing the function of transmitting monitoring and status data to LENA Manager. One Node Agent per physical server is the default, but multiple Node Agents can be configured as needed. LENA Web Server, LENA WAS, and LENA Session Server are configured under LENA Node, and LENA Node is configured under one System.</p>
</dd>
</dl>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="servermodule"><a class="link" href="#servermodule">1.3.2. Server Module</a></h4>
<div class="dlist">
<dl>
<dt class="hdlist1">LENA Web Server</dt>
<dd>
<p>LENA Web Server can transmit static content and integrates with LENA WAS in AJP or Reverse Proxy form, performing the front-end role for Web Application services provided by LENA WAS. Additionally, various optional additional functions can be used, with Domain/URI-based branching and Load Balancing functions and security layer (SSL) being representative.</p>
</dd>
<dt class="hdlist1">LENA WAS (Web Application Server)</dt>
<dd>
<p>LENA WAS executes Java Web Applications to provide Web Application services. It includes Datasource integration functionality for using DB Connection Pool and Session Server integration functionality for using Session Clustering. The following explains the two types of LENA WAS.</p>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>LENA WAS SE (Standard Edition)</strong><br>
It consists only of Servlet Engine for processing Java Class files and JSP Engine for processing JSP files, and can only execute WAR Type Web Applications. Compared to LENA WAS EE, it has the advantage of being relatively lightweight and fast.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>LENA WAS EE (Enterprise Edition)</strong><br>
In addition to the Engine provided by LENA WAS SE, it supports J2EE specifications such as EJB Engine, JMS Engine, and can execute WAR/EJB/EAR Type Applications. Additionally, it supports XA Datasource for 2 Phase Commit.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>LENA WAS internally mounts Advertiser Module, which collects LENA WAS’s JVM internal monitoring results through JMX and transmits them to LENA Manager.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="dlist">
<dl>
<dt class="hdlist1">LENA Session Server</dt>
<dd>
<p>LENA Session Server is provided to ensure high availability through WAS redundancy by sharing sessions between multiple LENA WAS. It is provided by default when using LENA Enterprise Edition, and Session Clustering can be configured through Active-Active Clustering (bidirectional Active-Standby) with 2 LENA Session Servers. To use LENA Session Server, no separate configuration is needed in the Application, and it can be implemented with simple configuration in LENA Manager.</p>
</dd>
</dl>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>However, all objects stored in HTTP Session must be serializable (Serializable) to perform Session-clustering.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_lena_operation_method"><a class="link" href="#_lena_operation_method">1.4. LENA Operation Method</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Node Agent is installed on Nodes registered in Manager, and Advertiser is installed on Application Server.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Operators send control requests for Server (e.g., Start, Stop, Reload, Dump, configuration changes, etc.) to each Node Agent through Manager’s UI, and Node Agent receives and executes the control.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Node Agent and Advertiser periodically transmit monitoring data to Manager, and operators can check resource status of each server through Manager’s UI such as Monitoring Dashboard. For Session Server, it directly transmits its own monitoring data to Manager.</p>
</div>

</div>

<div class="paragraph">
<p>LENA is divided into Standard and Enterprise Edition according to the functional scope provided by Application Server. While Standard Edition supports Web Application-centered specifications, Enterprise Edition supports J2EE specifications such as JTA, JMS, EJB and provides Session Clustering. <div class="sect1">
<h2 id="_log_inout"><a class="link" href="#_log_inout">2. Log In/Out</a></h2>
<div class="sectionbody">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides functionality for logging in and out of the Manager.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_log_in"><a class="link" href="#_log_in">2.1. Log In</a></h3>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/common_login.png" alt="common login">
</div>
<div class="title">Figure 2. Manager Access Screen</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can log in by entering your user ID and password.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When attempting to log in, if there are 7 or more password errors, you cannot log in with that user. In such cases, the password must be reset through the console.
(For detailed information, refer to the 'Manager admin password reset' section in the Appendix.)</p>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_openid_connect"><a class="link" href="#_openid_connect">2.1.1. OpenID Connect</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When OpenID Connect is enabled in the Manager Environment of the Admin menu, the OpenID Connect toggle is activated on the login screen. Through the OpenID Connect toggle, you can log in via authentication providers such as Keycloak.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_language_settings"><a class="link" href="#_language_settings">2.1.2. Language Settings</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can set the language to use in Manager from the Language option. (English, Korean, Chinese)</p>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The installed version is displayed on the bottom left of the login page, and technical support contact information is displayed on the right.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_log_out"><a class="link" href="#_log_out">2.2. Log Out</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can log out using the <span class="icon">door icon</span> on the top right of the Manager.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_theme_change"><a class="link" href="#_theme_change">2.3. Theme Change</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can set the theme through the Dark Theme menu in the <span class="icon">gear icon</span> menu on the top right of the Manager. You can choose between light mode and dark mode.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect1">
<h2 id="_dashboard"><a class="link" href="#_dashboard">3. Dashboard</a></h2>
<div class="sectionbody">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides a summary of system configuration information, resource monitoring, events, licenses, and other information managed by the Manager.</p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/dashboard_overview.png" alt="dashboard overview">
</div>
<div class="title">Figure 3. Dashboard</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The system list on the left side of the screen provides a list of systems that the logged-in user has permissions for.
All shows integrated information from all systems the user has permissions for.</p>
</div>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Member</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Total number of servers by type belonging to server clusters</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top" rowspan="3"><p class="tableblock">CHECK</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Modified Server</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Whether servers requiring restart exist among Servers included in the System</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Out of Cluster Sync</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Whether Server Clusters requiring sync exist</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Diagnostic Report</p></td>

</div></div></td>

</div></div></td>
</tr>

</div></div></td>

</tr>
<tr>

</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">OOM</p></td>

</div></div></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Full GC</p></td>

<p>Number of Full GC occurrences in Servers included in the System</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>RESOURCE</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">DB Resource</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Number of Databases and Datasources registered and managed in the RESOURCE menu</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Datasource legend</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Used : Number of Datasources currently in use by WAS</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Not Used : Number of Datasources not currently in use by WAS</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>LICENSE</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect1">
<h2 id="server_server"><a class="link" href="#server_server">4. Server</a></h2>
<div class="sectionbody">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides a screen for managing Node, WAS, Web Server, Session Server, and Memory Cache Server.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can check the number of Nodes and each Server within a specific System, and manage Node and Server status comprehensively in real-time.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_system"><a class="link" href="#_system">4.1. System</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>System is a logical group that contains multiple Servers.
"DefaultSystem" is provided by default, and users can create, modify, and delete Systems.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_list"><a class="link" href="#_list">4.1.1. List</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>System list is provided in tree format on the left side of the screen.</p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/server_1_system.png" alt="server 1 system">
</div>
<div class="title">Figure 4. System List</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_registration"><a class="link" href="#_registration">4.1.2. Registration</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Register(+) button</span> to create "Create System" in the list.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter the name of the system to create and press Enter.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">OK button</span> to save.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The permissions of the currently logged-in user are mapped to that System.
That is, only users with the same permissions as the logged-in user can view that System.
(Same applies to Node, Server, Resource)</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_modification"><a class="link" href="#_modification">4.1.3. Modification</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the System to modify.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Edit(pencil) button</span> to change the name of the selected System, then press Enter.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">OK button</span> to save.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_deletion"><a class="link" href="#_deletion">4.1.4. Deletion</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the System to delete.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Delete(-) button</span>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">OK button</span> to save.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Systems with Nodes underneath cannot be deleted. That is, only empty Systems can be deleted.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="server_node"><a class="link" href="#server_node">4.2. Node</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Node is a physical Server that contains multiple WAS, Web Server, and Session Server instances.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_list_2"><a class="link" href="#_list_2">4.2.1. List</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can manage each Node through the Node List.</p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/server_2_node.png" alt="server 2 node">
</div>
<div class="title">Figure 5. Node List</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The properties of Node are as follows.</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 4. Node Properties</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 16.6666%;">
<col style="width: 33.3333%;">
<col style="width: 50.0001%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Item (* indicates required value)</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Notes</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Node information change status</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>New/Modified/Deleted status of Node data</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="icon">+ icon</span><br>
  - Display change status when <span class="button">Register</span> / <span class="button">Edit(pencil)</span> button is clicked<br>
<span class="icon">- icon</span><br>
  - Display deletion pending when <span class="button">Delete(trash can)</span> is clicked</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Status</p></td>

</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Started(v)<br></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Stop(ㅁ)</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Name(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Node name</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Type(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Node Type</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>All<br>
  - Can install all types of Servers<br>
Application<br>
  - Can install WAS and Session Server<br>
Web<br>
  - Can install Web Server<br>
MDS<br>
  - Can install Cache Server</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Engine</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Engine type according to Node Type</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Application<br>
  - EN-7: Java EE 6 / Servlet 3.0 support<br>
  - EN-8: Java EE 7 / Servlet 3.1 support<br>
  - EN-9: Java EE 8 / Servlet 4.0 support<br>
  - EN-10: Servlet 6.0 support<br>
Web<br>
  - EN-A: JK, Proxy support<br>
  - EN-N: Proxy, Net-Gateway support<br>
MDS<br>
  - EN-R: Memory Cache support</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Address(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Node IP address</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Port(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Node Agent port number</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Default<br>
  - 16800 (when Node Type is All or Application)<br>
  - 16900 (when Node Type is Web)<br>
  - 16700 (when Node Type is MDS)<br></p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Manager Address(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Manager IP address</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Button area</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Displays Node information change and related function buttons</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="icon">Trash can icon</span><br>
  - Delete Node information<br>
<span class="icon">Pen icon</span><br>
  - Modify Node information<br>
<span class="icon">Terminal icon</span><br>
  - Provides SSH terminal functionality to the server where Node is installed<br>
<span class="icon">More icon</span><br>
  - Provides menu for JAVA Home setting and Start/Stop</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_install"><a class="link" href="#_install">4.2.2. Install</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Install button</span> to prepare Node information registration.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter Node property values.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span> to save.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 5. Properties set during Install</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 50%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Item (* indicates required value)</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Notes</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Node Type</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Node Type</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides the following types:</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Application: Can install WAS and Session Server</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Web: Can install Web Server</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Node Name(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Node name</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Node Address(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Node IP address</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Node Port(*)</p></td>

</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">

</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">User(*)</p></td>

</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>For Node Type Application, cannot run with root account. For Node Type Web, use root only when Web Server Port must be 1024 or below.</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Password(*)</p></td>

</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">SSH Port</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">

</div></div></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">LENA Home</p></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">JAVA Installation</p></td>

</div></div></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">JAVA Home</p></td>

</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Install functionality is only supported in Linux environment.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_register"><a class="link" href="#_register">4.2.3. Register</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Register button</span> to change Node information to registrable state.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter Node’s Name, Type, Address, Port, and Manager Address (default value is provided).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span> to save.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Manager IP is automatically entered as Node’s host IP.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Depending on network configuration, automatically entered IP may differ from actual network IP.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>In this case, you must modify and enter the Manager IP.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_modification_2"><a class="link" href="#_modification_2">4.2.4. Modification</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Edit(pencil) button</span> to change Node information to modifiable state.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Modify Node properties.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span> to save.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>When Node’s Address or Port needs to be changed due to port policy or firewall policy changes,
modify agent.conf settings and restart Node Agent.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>At this time, modify and enter Node’s Address and Port information so that Manager can also know the changed information.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When saving modified information, if 'Occured Read Timeout' message occurs, check the following cases:</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Port is being used by something other than Node Agent</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Node Agent is hung</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Network problem exists</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_deletion_2"><a class="link" href="#_deletion_2">4.2.5. Deletion</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Trash can button</span> to change Node information to deletable state.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span>.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If Servers are registered under a Node, that Node cannot be deleted.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Uninstall is only supported in Linux environment, and is possible only when selecting one node to delete.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_start"><a class="link" href="#_start">4.2.6. Start</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Can start nodes that are in stopped state.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the Start menu provided when selecting the <span class="button">…​ button</span> in the rightmost column of the Node list, then a popup window appears.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter User, Password, and SSH Port number, then press the <span class="button">Start button</span>.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_stop"><a class="link" href="#_stop">4.2.7. Stop</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Can stop nodes that are in running state.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the Stop menu provided when selecting the <span class="button">…​ button</span> in the rightmost column of the Node list, then a popup window appears.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter User, Password, and SSH Port number, then press the <span class="button">Stop button</span>.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_change_java_home"><a class="link" href="#_change_java_home">4.2.8. Change Java Home</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Can modify JAVA Home path for Node and Servers installed on Node.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Modify JAVA Home Path.</p>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Node Java Home Path : Edit Node Java Home Path.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Server Java Home Path : Edit JAVA Home path for selected servers. (Not supported in Web Node)</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Press the <span class="button">Save button</span>.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_node_terminal"><a class="link" href="#_node_terminal">4.2.9. Node Terminal</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Can access VM where target Node is installed through LENA Manager and use SSH terminal functionality.</p>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock important">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-important" title="Important"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>To use this functionality, you must meet the following requirements:</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Node must be running and able to communicate with LENA Manager.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>OS where Node is installed must be Linux-based (Windows-based not supported).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>OS account for Node installation/execution must allow SSH access through password authentication.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>This functionality reuses the connection between LENA Manager and Node, so no separate port work is necessary to use this terminal functionality.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Clicking the <span class="icon">terminal icon</span> in the Node list will show a popup screen for using the functionality, and<br>
entering the password of the OS account running Node Agent will execute the SSH terminal.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>For detailed settings of Node Terminal functionality, refer to the following Manager Configuration settings.</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 6. Manager Configuration(manager.conf) Node Terminal functionality setting options</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 28.5714%;">
<col style="width: 28.5714%;">
<col style="width: 42.8572%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Option key</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Default value</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">ssh.cmdCheck.mode.isWhiteList</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>true</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">  - When true, controls commands using whitelist method.<br>
  - When false, controls commands using blacklist method.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">ssh.cmdCheck.idleTimeout</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>600 (second)</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Disconnects connection after this time if no action is taken after terminal connection.<br>
(Minimum configurable value: 30)</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">ssh.cmdCheck.whitelist.view</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>view</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Set 'view' or 'vi' commands to allow when using whitelist method, separated by ','</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">ssh.cmdCheck.whitelist</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>cd,clear,echo,ll,ls,ps,tail,exit</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Set commands to allow when using whitelist method. (view, vi excluded)</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">ssh.cmdCheck.blacklist</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>alias,chmod,chown,cp,dd,export,rm,mkdir,mv,kill,sed,source,sudo,touch,vi</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Set commands to prohibit when using blacklist method, separated by ','</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="admonitionblock important">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-important" title="Important"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
Regardless of Manager Configuration settings, the following expressions cannot be used:
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="exampleblock">
<div class="content">
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre>'|' cannot be used except for '| grep' case</pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre>'&&' cannot be used</pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre>'>' or '>>' cannot be used</pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre>'()'(sub shell) and $(), and ``(backtick) cannot be used</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_was"><a class="link" href="#_was">4.3. WAS</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides screens for managing WAS.
Performs registration, modification, and deletion of Servers installed on Nodes, and can also install, remove, and clone Servers.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_list_3"><a class="link" href="#_list_3">4.3.1. List</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>WAS can be managed through the WAS List.</p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/server_3_application_server.png" alt="server 3 application server">
</div>
<div class="title">Figure 6. Web Application Server List</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>WAS attributes are as follows.</p>
</div>

</div></div></td>

</tr>
<tr>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Server start and stop</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Button area</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Displays server information change and related function buttons</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="icon">Trash icon</span><br>
  - Delete server information<br></p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="icon">Pen icon</span><br>
  - Edit server information<br></p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="icon">Log file icon</span><br>
  - Provides Server Log Viewer functionality<br></p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">

  - Provides menu for performing Start/Stop</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>

</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_install_2"><a class="link" href="#_install_2">4.3.2. Install</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Install button</span> to prepare for Server installation.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter Server Type, Server ID, etc.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span> to save.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>There may be differences between Servers actually installed on Nodes and Server information managed by Manager. (when installed via console)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>If Server ID duplication error occurs, use Register function to check additional information of installed Servers.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_clone"><a class="link" href="#_clone">4.3.3. Clone</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Clone button</span> to prepare for Server cloning.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select the Server to clone from Node List. Clone Server ID and Clone Service Port are automatically entered.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Modify Clone Server ID and Service Port to desired values.</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>(Include External Source is available when cloning servers to other nodes and sets whether to clone application files deployed on the server to be cloned.)</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span> to save.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>There may be differences between Servers actually installed on Nodes and Server information managed by Manager. (when installed via console)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>If Server ID duplication error occurs, use register function to check additional information of previously installed Servers.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>When remotely cloning WAS servers, Node’s Engine No. must be the same to clone WAS servers.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_register_2"><a class="link" href="#_register_2">4.3.4. Register</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Register button</span>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select the Server to register.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span> to save.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Installation is also possible from System > Application Server List Tab.
However, the Node to install must be selected from Node List.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_modification_3"><a class="link" href="#_modification_3">4.3.5. Modification</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Edit(pencil) button</span> to change Server information to modifiable state.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Modify Server attributes.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span> to save.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_deletion_3"><a class="link" href="#_deletion_3">4.3.6. Deletion</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Delete(trash) button</span> to change Server information to deletable state.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Press the <span class="button">OK button</span> to display a window for selecting deletion type.</p>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Deregister : Delete Server information only from Manager DB and maintain physical Server engine (can be re-registered later via <span class="button">Register button</span>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Uninstall : Delete Server information from Manager DB and also delete physical Server engine</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic" start="4">
<li>
<p>When Uninstall is selected, a window asking about log directory deletion is displayed.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When deleting WAS, the corresponding Server is deleted from the target list of service control (ADMIN > Security > Rule Applying menu).</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Servers bound to Server Cluster cannot be deleted.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When use Server Delete Protection value is set to true in Manager Configuration area of ADMIN > Preference > Manager Environment menu,
it can prevent servers from being uninstalled from Manager.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_startstop"><a class="link" href="#_startstop">4.3.7. Start/Stop</a></h4>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_single_startstop"><a class="link" href="#_single_startstop">Single Start/Stop</a></h5>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Stop button</span> to stop the Server.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Start button</span> to start the Server.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock important">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-important" title="Important"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>When stopping Server, WAS stops after all tasks being serviced are completed.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>If tasks are not completed even after Shutdown Timeout time in <a href="#server_was_general">General</a> tab, it is forcibly stopped.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When Server is started, a popup for viewing log files is executed. You can check whether Server started normally through the popup.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="button">Start button</span> is activated only when in startable state.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_multi_startstop"><a class="link" href="#_multi_startstop">Multi Start/Stop</a></h5>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select multiple Servers to start or stop.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Multi Action button</span> at the bottom of Server list.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select Action Type in popup window and click <span class="button">Action button</span> to perform start or stop operations for multiple Servers.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
After Start / Stop commands in popup screen, the requested command is not stopped even if popup is closed.
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_forced_stoprestart"><a class="link" href="#_forced_stoprestart">Forced Stop/Restart</a></h5>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Additional function(…​) button</span> at the far right of Server list.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Perform forced stop or forced restart.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
When performing forced stop or restart, all currently serviced tasks are immediately stopped, so caution is required.
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="WAS_SettingInfoManage"><a class="link" href="#WAS_SettingInfoManage">4.3.8. Configuration Information Management</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides functionality to change Server configuration information.
Select the Server name to change from Server list.
For Standard Edition, General, Session, Logging, Web Configuration, Environment, Properties, Audit, Configuration Tree, History, TunA tabs are provided, and backup is performed when modifying configuration information for restoration.
Enterprise Edition additionally provides Container tab.</p>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When changing Server configuration, Server restart is required to reflect modified items</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="server_was_general"><a class="link" href="#server_was_general">General</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Manages general configuration information of Server.
Port information, Connector information, and Stuck Thread related settings can be modified and saved.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Detailed contents of configuration information are as follows.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>

<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_environment"><a class="link" href="#_environment">Environment</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides screen for managing JVM options, Start Shell configuration, and System Properties (provided only in Enterprise Edition).
Modify through file editor and click <span class="button">Save button</span> to save.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>JVM Env (/bin/setenv.sh): JVM options for Server execution</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Custom Env (/bin/customenv.sh): User custom environment variable configuration</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Base Env (/env.sh): Shell Script for Server startup</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Do not modify JVM_ROUTE value directly here, but use <span class="button">Load button</span> in JvmRoute item in Server Info area of General tab to modify.
If modified directly here, Manager DB information is not updated, causing DB value mismatch.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>System.properties(/conf/system.properties)
(This item can only be checked in Enterprise Edition)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Catalina.properties (/conf/catalina.properties): Server’s Catalina configuration</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="literalblock">
<div class="content">
<pre>is WAS's default installation directory.
is originally used when creating directories to use multiple Instances for one WAS and specifying directories for each Instance, but in LENA, WAS and Instance have 1:1 relationship, so is used as .</pre>
</div>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>By default, configuration cannot be modified as it is Disabled, but if you want to modify,
click <span class="button">Configuration button</span> in ADMIN > Manager Environment > Manager Configuration item and change the following configuration to false.</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash">server.environment.envshell.readonly=false</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_properties"><a class="link" href="#_properties">Properties</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides screen for checking Server’s System Properties and System Environments.
Key Properties among System Properties are provided separately to check main information such as Server path, JAVA version, etc.
Information can only be checked when Server is running.</p>
</div>
</div>

If Server is started without container configuration, EJB required container is created with default configuration.
If configuration changes other than default are needed, container must be created to change configuration.</p>

<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="server-audit"><a class="link" href="#server-audit">Audit</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Function for collecting/managing events occurring in WAS.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Collected event information can be checked in event dashboard.
For event dashboard related content, refer to <a href="#_event_dashboard">Event Dashboard</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Four types of Detection Rules can be set to collect events.</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 30. OOM Detection Rule</caption>

</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Enable</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Detects Out Of Memory Error occurrence</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : true</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Enable</p></td>

</table>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>

</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>LenaStuckThreadDetectionValve is basically configured in server.xml,
and LenaStuckThreadDetectionValve related configuration can be done in Stuck Thread item of SERVER > Server selection > General tab screen.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When user request processing time exceeds Threshold configuration value, event occurs and is sent to Manager.</p>
</div>

</tr>

</tr>

<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Exception classes that can be detected are not Exceptions included in Java’s own library, but Exceptions of Application or Framework.
Exception patterns must be defined to prevent too many events from occurring.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Audit functionality is provided in Enterprise Edition.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_configuration_tree"><a class="link" href="#_configuration_tree">Configuration Tree</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Configuration files under /conf folder under WAS installation path can be managed through file editor.</p>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>User running Node Agent must have access permission to WAS configuration information files for modification. If access permission is not available, message that file cannot be edited due to no Write permission is displayed.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_history"><a class="link" href="#_history">History</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides backup and restore functionality for configuration information. When configuration information is modified and saved, History is managed by type.
Search by entering modification date and configuration file Type.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click <span class="button">View(magnifying glass) button</span> to view information of selected file,
and click <span class="button">Restore button</span> to restore to that configuration file.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_resource_management"><a class="link" href="#_resource_management">4.3.9. Resource Management</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When Resources menu under Server menu is selected, screen for managing Resource information related to that Server is displayed.
By default, information for DataSource, JMS, JTA Resources can be managed.
(JMS, JTA Resources are supported only for Enterprise Server)</p>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Methods for setting Resources in WAS are as follows.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Add : Click <span class="button">New button</span> to add Resource. (Datasource, JMS possible)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Delete : Click <span class="button">Delete button</span> to delete Resource. (Datasource, JMS possible)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Import : Click <span class="button">Import button</span> to import Resources registered in RESOURCE menu. (Datasource, JMS, JTA possible)</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="WAS_DataSource"><a class="link" href="#WAS_DataSource">DataSource</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides functionality to manage JNDI DataSource that can be used by WAS Applications.
JNDI can be set so all Applications running on Server can share and use, or
JNDI can be set for each Application for use.
For Enterprise Edition, JTA is supported so additional attributes are added.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Server DataSource Configuration</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Set DataSource shared by all Applications running on Server.
List of DataSources available on Server can be queried, and DataSource registration, modification, deletion is possible.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Connection test can also be performed to check DataSource status.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>DataSource attributes are as follows. Attributes not visible on initial screen are
displayed when <span class="button">Expand all button</span> is clicked.</p>
</div>

</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">MaxWait(ms)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Maximum time to wait when no available Connection in Pool (ms)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : 30000</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">MinEvictableIdleTimeMillis(ms)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Connections existing in Pool in idle state for longer than this time
become removal targets (ms)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Default : 60000 (60s)</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>(1800000 (30m) when XaDataSource = true)</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">ValidationQuery</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Connection validity verification query</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : null</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">ValidationInterval</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Connection validity verification cycle (ms)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : 3000</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">TestOnBorrow</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Before taking connection from Pool, perform query set in validationQuery
to check connection validity</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : default</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">TestOnReturn</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Before returning connection to Pool, perform query set in validationQuery
to check connection validity</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : default</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">TestWhileIdle</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">For idle connections, perform query set in validationQuery
to check connection validity</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : default</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">LogValidationErrors</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Whether to output errors when errors occur after validation query execution</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : default(false)</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">TimeBetweenEvictionRunsMillis(ms)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Thread execution cycle for extracting unused Connections (ms)</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : 5000</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">RemoveAbandoned</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Whether to detect Connection loss</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : default</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">RemoveAbandonedTimeout(s)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Timeout value for determining lost Connection (s)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : 60</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">LogAbandoned</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Whether to log when processing Connection loss</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : default</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">AbandonWhenPercentageFull</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Abandon is performed only when Connection pool exceeds set occupancy rate</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : 100</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">JdbcInterceptors</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">User-defined functionality can be added using flexible and pluggable interceptors</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">When setting QueryTimeout, enter QueryTimeoutInterceptor(queryTimeout=time(seconds))</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When Default value is default instead of true or false, JDBC Driver’s default value is used.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Additional attributes for Enterprise Edition are as follows.</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 35. Enterprise Edition Additional Attributes</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 50%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Item (* indicates required values)</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Notes</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">JtaManaged</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Whether to use JTA</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : false</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">XaDataSource</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Whether to use XA</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : false</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>XADataSource configuration can only be used when JTA is configured, and when XADataSource is configured, validationInterval, logValidationErrors, abandonWhenPercentageFull attributes cannot be used.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>When DataSource is set to Context scope, all Applications share it.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>In EnterpriseServer, DataSource can also be set to Context scope, but Lookup is not possible in EJB.
Setting to Global + ResourceLink scope is recommended for EnterpriseServer.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Password encryption algorithm uses AES. Key value for encryption is managed as "datasource.key=keyvalue" in Manager LENA Home sub /repository/conf/manager.conf file and each WAS Home sub /conf/advertiser.conf.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic" start="2">
<li>
<p>Databases</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When setting URL, register by creating Databases with information to be used commonly.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click <span class="button">Add(+) button</span> to create popup window.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist loweralpha">
<ol class="loweralpha" type="a">
<li>
<p>Enter Resource Name to distinguish Databases.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Check automatically filled DriverClassName. Change if necessary.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter Address (IP and port) and save.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic" start="3">
<li>
<p>JDBC driver Upload</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>JDBC Driver library can be uploaded through Manager.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click <span class="button">Upload button</span> under DataSource detailed information to display upload screen as follows.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist loweralpha">
<ol class="loweralpha" type="a">
<li>
<p>Select file to upload through Search button.
File to upload is JDBC Driver library, so only JAR format files can be selected.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click Upload button to upload selected file to target directory.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Path where JDBC Driver file is uploaded is ${SERVER_HOME}/lib/datasource.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic" start="4">
<li>
<p>Connection Test</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click <span class="button">Connection Test button</span> in DataSource detailed screen to
perform connection test for configured DataSource.
When connection is successful, "JDBC Connection is successfully tested" message is displayed.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If "Driver Class[class name] does not exist." error message is displayed,
check if corresponding driver class is properly uploaded and classpath is configured.</p>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>classpath is added in WAS details > Environment > JVM Settings.</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="title">Configuration Example</div>
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash">CLASSPATH="$\{CLASSPATH}:$\{CATALINA_HOME}/lib/datasource/ojdbc6.jar"</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">

<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="WAS_JTA"><a class="link" href="#WAS_JTA">JTA</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>For Enterprise Edition, provides functionality to change Transaction Manager configuration.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>To use Transaction Manager configuration with default settings, select Auto for Managed Type.
(default during installation)</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>To change Transaction Manager configuration, select User Defined.
(When User Defined is selected, Recovery option is defaulted to "No")</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Main Configuration</p>
</li>

</tr>

<p>When there is no separate deployment system, applications can be uploaded through Manager.</p>

<li>
<p>After selecting server, select Applications to move to Application screen.</p>

</li>

</ol>

</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_configuration_information_management"><a class="link" href="#_configuration_information_management">Configuration Information Management</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When Application Name is selected from Application list query screen, Application configuration management screen can be queried.
Provides configuration and management functionality for Application Descriptor and DataSource.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Application configuration changes are possible only for selected Server.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect5">
<h6 id="WAS_Application_Settings"><a class="link" href="#WAS_Application_Settings">Application Settings</a></h6>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Manages information configured in Application Descriptor.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click <span class="button">Back(←) button</span> to return to Application list screen.
Click <span class="button">Expand all button</span> to configure additional Context attributes.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>DocBase and ContextPath cannot be modified, and detailed information of attributes is as follows.
Attributes not visible on initial screen can be checked by clicking <span class="button">Expand all button</span>.</p>

<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_server_log_viewer"><a class="link" href="#_server_log_viewer">4.3.11. Server Log Viewer</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Log Viewer button on right side of server list allows browsing log file contents under target server’s Log Home path.</p>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock important">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-important" title="Important"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>To use this functionality, the following must be satisfied.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Node to which target server belongs must be running.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click Log Viewer button in server list to check directories and files in tree structure based on target server’s Log Home path.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When file is selected, file contents are queried, and when first selected, file contents from end of file up to predetermined size can be checked.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Use Load More, Load Previous buttons to query and check log file contents by predetermined size.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>When using Load Previous button and no more content to query (eg. beginning of file), Alert message that no more data can be read is displayed.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>When using Load More button and no more content to query (eg. end of file), message that no more data can be read is displayed at bottom of screen.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
