<ul>
<li>
<p>HTTP</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>HTTPS</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Port</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>HTTP/HTTPS port number</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Start/Stop button</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Server start and stop</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Button area</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Displays server information change and related function buttons</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="icon">Trash icon</span><br>
  - Delete server information<br></p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="icon">Pen icon</span><br>
  - Edit server information<br></p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="icon">Log file icon</span><br>
  - Provides Server Log Viewer functionality<br></p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_install_3"><a class="link" href="#_install_3">4.4.2. Install</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Install button</span> to prepare for Server installation.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter Server ID and Service Port.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span> to save.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>There may be differences between Servers actually installed on Nodes and Server information managed by Manager. (when installed via console)</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If Server ID duplication error occurs, use Register function to check additional information of installed Servers.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_clone_2"><a class="link" href="#_clone_2">4.4.3. Clone</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Clone button</span> to prepare for Web Server cloning.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select Node List to select Server to clone.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter Clone Server ID and Service Port.</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>(Include External Source is available when cloning servers to other nodes and sets whether to clone files in Document Root directory of server to be cloned.)</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span> to save.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>There may be differences between Servers actually installed on Nodes and Server information managed by Manager. (when installed via console)</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If Server ID duplication error occurs, use Register function to check additional information of installed Servers.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_register_3"><a class="link" href="#_register_3">4.4.4. Register</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Register button</span>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select the Server to register.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span> to save.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_modification_4"><a class="link" href="#_modification_4">4.4.5. Modification</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Edit(pencil) button</span> to change Server information to modifiable state.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Modify Server attributes.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span> to save.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_deletion_4"><a class="link" href="#_deletion_4">4.4.6. Deletion</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Delete(trash) button</span> to change Server information to deletable state.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Press the <span class="button">OK button</span> to display a window for selecting deletion type.</p>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Deregister : Delete Server information only from Manager DB and maintain physical Server engine (can be re-registered later via <span class="button">Register button</span>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Uninstall : Delete Server information from Manager DB and also delete physical Server engine</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic" start="4">
<li>
<p>When Uninstall is selected, a window asking about log directory deletion is displayed.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Servers bound to Server Cluster cannot be deleted.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When use Server Delete Protection value is set to true in Manager Configuration area of ADMIN > Preference > Manager Environment menu,
it can prevent servers from being uninstalled from Manager.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_startstop_2"><a class="link" href="#_startstop_2">4.4.7. Start/Stop</a></h4>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_single_startstop_2"><a class="link" href="#_single_startstop_2">Single Start/Stop</a></h5>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Stop button</span> to stop the Server.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Start button</span> to start the Server.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock important">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-important" title="Important"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When stopping Server, shutdown method varies according to Stop Mode in <a href="#server_weba_general">General</a> tab.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Stop : Basic shutdown option that does not guarantee currently serviced tasks.<br>
Graceful Stop : Shuts down after completing currently serviced tasks. (Service not guaranteed on Windows)</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="button">Start button</span> is activated only when in startable state.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_multi_server_startstop"><a class="link" href="#_multi_server_startstop">Multi Server Start/Stop</a></h5>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select multiple Servers to start or stop.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Multi Action button</span> at the bottom of Server list.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select Action Type in popup window and click <span class="button">Action button</span> to perform start or stop operations for multiple Servers.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_forced_stoprestart_2"><a class="link" href="#_forced_stoprestart_2">Forced Stop/Restart</a></h5>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">…​ button</span> at the far right of Server list.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Perform forced stop or forced restart.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_configuration_information_management_en_a"><a class="link" href="#_configuration_information_management_en_a">4.4.8. Configuration Information Management (EN-A)</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides functionality to change configuration information of Web Server’s EN-A engine.
When Server is selected from Web Server list, it moves to screen for managing configuration information.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="server_weba_general"><a class="link" href="#server_weba_general">General</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>General configuration values and Connection, Process information of Web Server can be edited.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Web Server’s configuration information performs Validation on configuration files when saving,
minimizing Server startup failures due to configuration file errors.</p>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When configuration file error occurs, file is not saved and error message is displayed</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="title">Error message example</div>
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash">AH00526: Syntax error on line 253 Argument for 'Require all' must be 'granted' or 'denied'</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Detailed contents of configuration information are as follows.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Server Info (env.sh and /conf/httpd.conf file management)</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 48. Server Info</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 50%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Item (* indicates required values)</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Notes</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">HTTP Port(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>HTTP Port</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">HTTPS Port(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>HTTPS Port</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Staging HTTP Port</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Service port used when starting in Staging mode</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Used during Graceful restart</p>
<p class="tableblock">LENA uses basic nostage mode</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Staging HTTPS Port</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>HTTPS port used when starting in Staging mode</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Used during Graceful restart</p>
<p class="tableblock">LENA uses basic nostage mode</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Install Path</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Server installation path</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Document Root(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Basic folder path where documents provided by Web Server are stored</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Welcome Page</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Define which file to use as initial page document of website</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Stop Mode</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Option referenced when Web Server shuts down</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Stop : Basic shutdown option that does not guarantee currently serviced tasks.</p>
<p class="tableblock">Graceful Stop : Shuts down after completing currently serviced tasks. (Service not guaranteed on Windows)</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Directory/Path</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Directory path where web documents are located to set which services and functions to allow/deny</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Directory/Options</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Access control settings to apply to all files and directories under specified directory</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Indexes : Prevents showing file list under Document Root when welcome page cannot be found</p>
<p class="tableblock">FollowSymLinks : Prevents accessing file system other than existing web documents under Document Root via symbolic links</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Directory/Allow Override</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Set which directives to allow for resource access control configuration files for each subdirectory under Document Root (generally
AccessFileName : .htaccess)</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Provides following types</p>
<p class="tableblock">* None : Do not allow any directives
* All : All directives available
* AuthConfig : Allow user authentication directives
* FileInfo : Allow document type control directives
* Indexes : Allow directory indexing control directives
* Limit : Allow host access control directives</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Directory/Require</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Verify whether authenticated users perform allowed Actions</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic" start="2">
<li>
<p>Connection Info (/conf/extra/httpd-default.conf file management)</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 49. Connection Info</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 50%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Item (* indicates required values)</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Notes</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Timeout(s)(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Time for Server to wait and disconnect connection when no event occurs for certain time after connection between client and Server (s)</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : 60</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Keep Alive(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Whether specific process continues to handle specific user’s request tasks</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : On</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Max Keep Alive Requests(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Valid value when KeepAlive is On, process handles specific user’s requests for specified number of times</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When this value is exceeded, that process dies and another process handles requests</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : 100</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Keep Alive Timeout(s)(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Valid value when KeepAlive is On, timeout to disconnect connection when no request for set time (s)</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : 5</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Request Read Timeout(s)(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Time to wait for receiving request header and body from user</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If not received within set time, sends 408 REQUEST TIME OUT error</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : header=20-40,MinRate=500 body=20,MinRate=500</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic" start="3">
<li>
<p>Process Info (/conf/extra/httpd-mpm.conf file management)</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 50. Process Info</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 50%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Item (* indicates required values)</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Notes</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Start Servers(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Number of Server processes initialized when Web Server starts</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : 2</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Server Limit(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Maximum process value that MaxClients can create</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : 8</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Threads Per Child(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Number of Threads created by each child process</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : 128</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Thread Limit(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Maximum configurable value for ThreadsPerChild</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : 128</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Min Spare Threads(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>When number of Idle Threads in Idle state is less than this value, Threads increase to this value and maintain</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : 128</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Max Spare Threads(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>When number of Idle Threads in Idle state is more than this value, Threads decrease to this value and maintain</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : 256</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Max Request Workers(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Maximum number of Threads that all child processes can create</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : 1024</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Max Connection Per Child(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Maximum number of requests that child process can service. After processing this many requests, it terminates.</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default : 0 (0: unlimited)</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">

<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="weba_Connector"><a class="link" href="#weba_Connector">Connector</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Manages information for linking Web Server and WAS.<br>
Connector page is divided into JK and Proxy tabs according to linking method, and Connector configuration information according to module can be edited in each tab.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect5">
<h6 id="_jk"><a class="link" href="#_jk">JK</a></h6>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Edits configuration information when using JK(mod_jk).<br></p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/server_4_web_server_jk.png" alt="server 4 web server jk">
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>JK tab configuration is divided into three areas: Connector Info, Load Balancer, and URI Pattern Group as shown in the above screen.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic" start="1">
<li>
<p>Connector Info<br>
Manages basic configuration values of JK.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/server_4_web_server_jk_connector_info.png" alt="server 4 web server jk connector info">
</div>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 54. Connector Info (JK)</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 50%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Item (* indicates required values)</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Notes</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Type(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Protocol used when Web Server and WAS communicate.<br>
(ajp12, ajp13, ajp14, jni, lb and status can be used, but ajp13, lb, status are recommended.)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: ajp13</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Load Balancing Factor(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Load balancing index of WAS. That is, work allocation ratio.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 1</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Request Read Timeout(s)(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Timeout(seconds) used for communication channel between JK and remote host. If remote host does not respond within specified timeout, JK generates error and retries.<br>
When set to 0(default), JK continues to wait for response in all socket operations.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 300</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Socket Connect Timeout(s)(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Threshold for time(seconds) taken to configure socket connection between JK and remote host. If socket connection cannot be configured within specified time, JK generates error and attempts reconnection.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 5</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Socket Keep Alive(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">When firewall exists between Web Server and WAS, inactive connections are discarded, but when this attribute is TRUE, sends KEEP_ALIVE message to operating system to prevent firewall from disconnecting inactive connections.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: TRUE</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Connect Timeout(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">connectTimeout: Wait time(s) for cpong respond to cping request in ajp13 protocol after connection between JK and WAS is completed.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 10</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Connection Pool Size(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Number of connections maintained as connection pool between JK and WAS.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 128</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Connection Pool Min Size(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Minimum number of connections maintained as connection pool between JK and WAS.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 32</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Connection Pool Timeout(s)(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Specifies time(seconds) that JK must maintain before closing inactive sockets. When set to 0, disables socket closing.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Used together with WAS’s connectionTimeout option.<br>
Default: 20</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Log Level(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Specifies log level to be recorded in log file.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: error</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Log Format(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Sets format for recording logs in log file.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: "[%a %b %d %H:%M:%S %Y]"</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Status(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Whether to set Server status monitoring configuration value, Status Url and Allow IP can be configured when Enable is selected.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: Enable</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Status Url(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">URL for Server status monitoring.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: /jk-status/</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Status Allow IP(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">IP that can access Server status monitoring URL.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 127.0.0.1</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Type of server that Worker points to.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Standard or Enterprise is displayed as value.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Redirect</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">When this Worker is in error state, sets Failover Worker to handle requests received by this Worker.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: NONE</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Load Balancing Factor</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Work allocation ratio, defines how much work this Worker will do compared to other Workers.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 1</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Route ID</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Route ID of Worker.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Order</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Can change order between Workers.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>

</table>

<p>URI Pattern Group<br>
Defines URI Mapping to pass requests coming to Web Server to WAS by checking URI patterns.</p>

<div class="sect5">
<h6 id="_proxy"><a class="link" href="#_proxy">Proxy</a></h6>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Edits configuration information when using Proxy(mod_proxy).</p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/server_4_web_server_proxy.png" alt="server 4 web server proxy">
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Proxy tab configuration is divided into four areas: Connector Info, Load Balancer, URI Pattern Group, and Enable Custom.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic" start="1">
<li>
<p>Connector Info<br>
Manages basic configuration values of Proxy.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/server_4_web_server_proxy_connector_info.png" alt="server 4 web server proxy connector info">
</div>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 59. Connector Info (Proxy)</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 50%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Item (* indicates required values)</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Notes</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Socket Connect Timeout(s)(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Time(s) for Apache httpd to wait until connection creation to backend is completed.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 5</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">DNS Lookup Interval(s)(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">DNS lookup interval. Set to 0 to disable function.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 10</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Request Read Timeout(s)(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Time(seconds) for Apache httpd to wait for transmitted data sent and received from backend.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 300</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Background ServerFault Check Interval(s)(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">When Member connected to backend server is in error state, checks server at interval(seconds) set in this item and retransmits requests when server operates normally. Set to 0 to disable function.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 10</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">ServerFault Retry Time(s)(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">When Member connected to backend server is in error state, does not transmit any requests to that server until Apache httpd timeout(seconds) expires.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Background ServerFault Check Interval item is modifiable when 0.<br>
Default: 60</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic" start="2">
<li>
<p>Load Balancer<br>
Manages basic configuration and Members of Load Balancer for load balancing.<br>
Load Balancer area has Overview tab and Configuration tab. Overview tab can check overall information of currently created Load Balancer, and Configuration tab can configure detailed contents of Load Balancer.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Sticky Session(*)</p></td>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">* R[equest] : Selects Member with least requests. (Default)<br></p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">* T[raffic] : Selects Member with least network traffic.<br></p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">* B[usyness] : Selects Member with least load based on number of requests.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Protocol Type(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Specifies protocol type of Member. Can only be changed when Member is not specified.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: HTTP</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">SSL Enable</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Uses SSL/TLS protocol engine for Proxy.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">This option cannot be configured and operates only according to Protocol configuration.<br>
Default: Off when HTTP, On when HTTPS</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">SSLProxyCheckPeerExpire</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Checks if remote server certificate has expired.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: On</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">SSLProxyCheckPeerCN</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Checks CN field of remote server certificate.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: Off</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="paragraph">

When Add Member button is pressed, window for adding Member is displayed on screen, and users can select servers managed by LENA Manager as Members in this window or directly input Member information to add.</p>

<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_virtual_host"><a class="link" href="#_virtual_host">Virtual Host</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Web Server’s Virtual Host information can be registered/modified/cloned/deleted.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="button">Create button</span>, <span class="button">Delete button</span> can register/delete Virtual Host, <span class="button">Clone button</span> can clone, <span class="button">Rename button</span> can change name.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Virtual Hosts with one or more Load Balancers applied cannot be deleted.
If you want to delete that Virtual Host, first change Virtual Host ID of Load Balancer to different Virtual Host ID through Connector tab.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When SSL Enabled and Rewrite Enabled are checked, detailed item areas are additionally displayed as follows.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Detailed contents of configuration information are as follows.</p>
</div>
<div class="dlist">
<dl>
<dt class="hdlist1">Managed files </dt>
<dd>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>/conf/extra/vhost/{Virtual Host ID}.conf<br></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>/conf/extra/rewrite/rewrite_{Virtual Host ID}.conf <br></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>/conf/extra/ssl/ssl_{Virtual Host ID}.conf <br></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>/conf/extra/vhost/custom_{Virtual Host ID}.conf</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</div>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Homepage directory location of that virtual host</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Can be specified to same or subdirectory using Server’s DocumentRoot variable ${DOC_ROOT}</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Domain Name(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Domain name to identify virtual host</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Server Alias</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>ServerAlias used by virtual host</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Can include wildcard characters (*.example.com)</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Custom Log(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Web log file location of virtual host</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Directory/Path</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Path from DocumentRoot</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Directory/Options</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Access control settings to apply to all files and directories under specified directory</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>-Indexes prevents showing file list under Document Root when welcome page cannot be found</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>-FollowSymLinks prevents accessing file system other than existing web documents under Document Root via symbolic links</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Directory/Allow Override</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Set which directives to allow for resource access control configuration files for each subdirectory under Document Root
(generally AccessFileName : .htaccess)</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides following types</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>None : Do not allow any directives</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>All : All directives available</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>AuthConfig : Allow user authentication directives</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>FileInfo : Allow document type control directives</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Indexes : Allow directory indexing control directives</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Limit : Allow host access control directives</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Directory/Require</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Verify whether authenticated users perform allowed Actions</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Connector Enable</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Whether to configure virtual host Connector</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Connector Type/ID</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>When configuring virtual host Connector, select according to Jk/Proxy type</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Displays Connector list created in Connector Tab.</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Rewrite Enable</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Whether to use Rewrite</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Rewrite Configuration</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Detailed Rewrite configuration. Rewrites according to rules set in Rewrite Rule according to specified Rewrite Condition</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Enable Custom</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Add configurations that users want to add to Vhost arbitrarily</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Contents are generated and stored in separate file (/conf/http/vhost/custom/custom_default.conf).</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">SSL Enabled</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Whether to use SSL</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">SSL Port(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>HTTPS Port</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">SSL Certificate File(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>SSL certificate path</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">SSL Certificate Key File(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>SSL certificate Key file path</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">SSL Certificate Chain File</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>PEM-encoded server CA certificate file path</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">SSL CA Certificate File</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>ROOT certificate path</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">SSL Password</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>ROOT certificate password</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Https Redirect Enabled</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Whether to use Http→Https Redirect</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">SSL Log Separation</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Whether to use SSL Log configuration separation</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">SSL Custom Log(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>SSL Custom Log configuration</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Enable SSL/TLS Security</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>SSL security configuration per VirtualHost</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Instead of using General SSL/TLS security configuration, SSL/TLS security configuration is applied per VirtualHost.</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When changing configuration, Server restart is required to reflect modified items</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_logging_2"><a class="link" href="#_logging_2">Logging</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Web Server’s log configuration information can be edited.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Detailed contents of configuration information are as follows.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">

<p>Log Home</p>
</li>
</ol>

Log Home Prefix item allows input of log directory home path</p></td>

<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_environment_2"><a class="link" href="#_environment_2">Environment</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides screen for managing JVM options, Start Shell configuration, etc.
Modify through file editor and click <span class="button">Save button</span> to save.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Custom Env (/bin/customenv.sh): User custom environment variable configuration</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Base Env (/env.sh) - Shell Script for Server startup</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>By default, configuration cannot be modified. If you want to modify,
click <span class="button">Configuration button</span> in ADMIN > Manager Environment > Manager Configuration item and change the following configuration to false.</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash">server.environment.envshell.readonly=false</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_configuration_tree_2"><a class="link" href="#_configuration_tree_2">Configuration Tree</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Web Server’s ${SERVER_HOME}/conf directory sub configuration files can be managed through file editor.</p>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>User running Node Agent must have access permission to Web Server configuration information files for modification.
If access permission is not available, message that file cannot be edited due to no Write permission is displayed.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_history_2"><a class="link" href="#_history_2">History</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides backup and restore functionality for configuration information.
When configuration information is modified and saved, History is managed. Search by entering modification date.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click <span class="button">View(magnifying glass) button</span> to view information of selected file,
and click <span class="button">Restore button</span> to restore to that configuration file.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_configuration_information_management_en_n"><a class="link" href="#_configuration_information_management_en_n">4.4.9. Configuration Information Management (EN-N)</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides functionality to change engine configuration information of EN-N type Web Server.
When Server is selected from Web Server list, it moves to screen for managing configuration information.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="server_webn_general"><a class="link" href="#server_webn_general">General</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>General configuration values and Connection, Process information of Web Server can be edited.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Web Server’s configuration information performs Validation on configuration files when saving, minimizing Server startup failures due to configuration file errors.</p>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When configuration file error occurs, file is not saved and error message is displayed</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="title">Error message example</div>
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash">AH00526: Syntax error on line 253 Argument for 'Require all' must be 'granted' or 'denied'</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Detailed contents of configuration information are as follows.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Server Info (/var/common_value.env file management)</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/server_5_general_serverInfo.png" alt="server 5 general serverInfo">
</div>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">

<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 50%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Item (* indicates required values)</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Notes</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Install Path</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Server installation path</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Base Port(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Port Type information and Port Number set during installation</p>
</div></div></td>

<p>Port Type cannot be changed, Port Number can be changed</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>

<p>Define which file to use as initial page document of website</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>

<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="webn_Connector"><a class="link" href="#webn_Connector">Connector</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Manages information for linking Web Server and WAS(Backend).<br>
Connector page is divided into Proxy and Net Gateway tabs according to protocol, and Connector configuration information according to module can be edited in each tab.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect5">
<h6 id="_proxy_2"><a class="link" href="#_proxy_2">Proxy</a></h6>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Edits configuration information when using Proxy(ngx_http_upstream_module).<br></p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/server_5_web_server_proxy.png" alt="server 5 web server proxy">
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Proxy tab configuration is divided into three areas: Connector Info, Load Balancer, and URI Pattern Group as shown in the above screen.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic" start="1">
<li>
<p>Connector Info<br>
Manages basic configuration values of Proxy.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/server_5_web_server_proxy_connector_info.png" alt="server 5 web server proxy connector info">
</div>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 77. Connector Info (Proxy)</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 50%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Item (* indicates required values)</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Notes</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Proxy Read Timeout(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Timeout time set for reading response from backend server. This is timeout time between two consecutive read operations, not total response transmission timeout time. If backend server sends nothing within time specified in proxy_read_timeout, connection is closed.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 300</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Proxy Connect Timeout(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Define time limit for establishing connection with backend server. This time limit generally cannot exceed 75 seconds.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 5</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Background ServerFault Check Interval(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">When Member connected to backend server is in error state, checks server at interval(seconds) set in this item and retransmits requests when server operates normally. Set to 0 to disable function.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 10</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Server Fault Retry Time(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">When Member connected to backend server is in error state, does not transmit any requests to that server until timeout(seconds) expires.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 60<br></p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Health Check Interval(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Checks server at interval(seconds) set for checking backend server status. Set to 0 to disable function.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 60</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">DNS Lookup Interval(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">DNS lookup interval. Set to 0 to disable function.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 10</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When Background ServerFault Check Interval and Health Check Interval are saved as 0<br>
All LoadBalancer’s Auto Server Fault Recovery values change to off, and new creation values are also fixed to off.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">

</li>

<div class="sect5">
<h6 id="_net_gateway"><a class="link" href="#_net_gateway">Net Gateway</a></h6>

</div>

<div class="paragraph">
<p>Net Gateway tab configuration is divided into two areas: Connector Info and Load Balancer.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic" start="1">
<li>
<p>Connector Info<br>
Manages basic configuration values of Net Gateway.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/server_5_web_server_stream_connector_info.png" alt="server 5 web server stream connector info">

<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Proxy Timeout(s)(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Set time limit between two consecutive read or write operations in client or proxy server connection. If data is not transmitted within this time, connection is closed.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 5</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Proxy Connect Timeout(s)(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Define timeout for establishing connection with proxy server</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 10</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">ServerFault Retry Time(s)(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Time period during which server is considered unavailable after specified number of server communication failures occur, period during which server is considered unavailable.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 60</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>

<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_virtual_host_2"><a class="link" href="#_virtual_host_2">Virtual Host</a></h5>
<div class="sect5">
<h6 id="_proxy_3"><a class="link" href="#_proxy_3">Proxy</a></h6>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Proxy Web Server’s Virtual Host information can be registered/modified/cloned/deleted.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="button">Create button</span>, <span class="button">Delete button</span> can register/delete Virtual Host, <span class="button">Clone button</span> can clone, <span class="button">Rename button</span> can change name.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Virtual Hosts with one or more Load Balancers applied cannot be deleted.
If you want to delete that Virtual Host, first change Virtual Host ID of Load Balancer to different Virtual Host ID through Connector tab.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When Enable SSL and Enable Rewrite and Enable Custom are checked, detailed item areas are additionally displayed.</p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/server_5_web_server_proxy_vhost.png" alt="server 5 web server proxy vhost">
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Detailed contents of configuration information are as follows.</p>
</div>
<div class="dlist">
<dl>
<dt class="hdlist1">Managed files </dt>
<dd>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>/conf/http/vhost/vhost_{Virtual Host ID}.conf<br></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>/conf/http/vhost/vhost.list<br></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>/conf/http/vhost/rewrite/rewrite_{Virtual Host ID}.conf<br></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>/conf/http/vhost/custom/custom_{Virtual Host ID}.conf</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</div>

<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Notes</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Virtual Host ID(*)</p></td>

</div></div></td>

</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>

IP used by that virtual host</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Port(*)</p></td>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>

</div></div></td>

</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>

</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>

<p>Homepage directory location of that virtual host</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Can be specified to same or subdirectory using Server’s DocumentRoot variable ${DOC_ROOT}</p>
</div></div></td>

</div></div></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Document base/Allowed Methods</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Allow access for specified http methods</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>

</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Access Log/Alias</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">

</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Access Log/Location</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Set location and name for log files</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">URI</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Select URI Pattern Group set in Connector Proxy Tab</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Not required selection</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Enable Rewrite</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Whether to use Rewrite function, creates input window below when checked</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Input content is generated and stored in separate file</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Enable Custom</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Whether to use Custom Configuration, creates input window below when checked</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Input content is generated and stored in separate file (/conf/http/vhost/custom/custom_default.conf)</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div class="sect5">
<h6 id="_net_gateway_2"><a class="link" href="#_net_gateway_2">Net Gateway</a></h6>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Net Gateway Web Server’s Virtual Host information can be registered/modified/cloned/deleted.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="button">Create button</span>, <span class="button">Delete button</span> can register/delete Virtual Host, <span class="button">Clone button</span> can clone, <span class="button">Rename button</span> can change name.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Virtual Hosts with one or more Load Balancers applied cannot be deleted.
If you want to delete that Virtual Host, first change Virtual Host ID of Load Balancer to different Virtual Host ID through Connector tab.</p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/server_5_web_server_stream_vhost.png" alt="server 5 web server stream vhost">
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Detailed contents of configuration information are as follows.</p>
</div>

<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_logging_3"><a class="link" href="#_logging_3">Logging</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Web Server’s log configuration information can be edited.</p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">

</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Detailed contents of configuration information are as follows.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Log Home</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>

<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_environment_3"><a class="link" href="#_environment_3">Environment</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides screen for managing JVM options, Start Shell configuration, etc.
Modify through file editor and click <span class="button">Save button</span> to save.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Custom Env (/bin/customenv.sh): User custom environment variable configuration</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Base Env (/env.sh) - Shell Script for Server startup</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>By default, configuration cannot be modified. If you want to modify,
click <span class="button">Configuration button</span> in ADMIN > Manager Environment > Manager Configuration item and change the following configuration to false.</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash">server.environment.envshell.readonly=false</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_configuration_tree_3"><a class="link" href="#_configuration_tree_3">Configuration Tree</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Web Server’s ${SERVER_HOME}/conf directory sub configuration files can be managed through file editor.</p>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>User running Node Agent must have access permission to Web Server configuration information files for modification.
If access permission is not available, message that file cannot be edited due to no Write permission is displayed.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_history_3"><a class="link" href="#_history_3">History</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides backup and restore functionality for configuration information.
When configuration information is modified and saved, History is managed. Search by entering modification date.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click <span class="button">View(magnifying glass) button</span> to view information of selected file,
and click <span class="button">Restore button</span> to restore to that configuration file.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_server_log_viewer_2"><a class="link" href="#_server_log_viewer_2">4.4.10. Server Log Viewer</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Log Viewer button on right side of server list allows browsing log file contents under target server’s Log Home path.</p>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock important">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-important" title="Important"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>To use this functionality, the following must be satisfied.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Node to which target server belongs must be running.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click Log Viewer button in server list to check directories and files in tree structure based on target server’s Log Home path.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When file is selected, file contents are queried, and when first selected, file contents from end of file up to predetermined size can be checked.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Use Load More, Load Previous buttons to query and check log file contents by predetermined size.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>When using Load Previous button and no more content to query (eg. beginning of file), Alert message that no more data can be read is displayed.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>When using Load More button and no more content to query (eg. end of file), message that no more data can be read is displayed at bottom of screen.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_session_server"><a class="link" href="#_session_server">4.5. Session Server</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides a screen for managing Session Server.
You can register, modify, and delete Session Servers installed on Nodes, and execute start and stop shells.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_list_6"><a class="link" href="#_list_6">4.5.1. List</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can manage each WAS through the Session Server List.</p>
</div>

  - Delete server information<br>
<span class="icon">Pen icon</span><br>
  - Modify server information<br>
<span class="icon">Log file icon</span><br>
  - Provides Server Log Viewer functionality<br>

  - Provides menu for performing Start/Stop</p>

<div class="paragraph">
<p>Session Server is a functionality provided by Enterprise Edition and is available when installing Enterprise version WAS.</p>
</div>
</td>

</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="session_install"><a class="link" href="#session_install">4.5.2. Install</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Install button</span>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter Server ID, Service Port, and Mirror Server IP/Port.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span> to save.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>There may be differences between the information of Servers actually installed on Nodes and Servers managed by Manager. (When installing via console)</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If a Server ID duplication error occurs, use the Register function to check previously installed Server information.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_register_4"><a class="link" href="#_register_4">4.5.3. Register</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Register button</span>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click on the Server to register.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span> to save.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_modification_5"><a class="link" href="#_modification_5">4.5.4. Modification</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Edit(pencil) button</span> to change Server information to modifiable state.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Modify Server properties.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span> to save.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_deletion_5"><a class="link" href="#_deletion_5">4.5.5. Deletion</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Delete(trash can) button</span> to change Server information to deletable state.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Press the <span class="button">OK button</span> to display a window for selecting deletion type.</p>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Deregister : Delete Server information only from Manager DB and maintain physical Server engine (can be re-registered later via <span class="button">Register button</span>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Uninstall : Delete Server information from Manager DB and also delete physical Server engine</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic" start="4">
<li>
<p>Uninstall selection, a window asking to delete the log directory is displayed.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Servers linked to a Server Cluster cannot be deleted.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When the use Server Delete Protection value in the Manager Environment menu of ADMIN > Preference > Manager Environment is set to true,
Manager can prevent the server from being uninstalled.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="session_startstop"><a class="link" href="#session_startstop">4.5.6. Start/Stop</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Stop button</span> to stop the Server.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Start button</span> to start the Server.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Only when the Server is in a state where it can be started, the <span class="button">Start button</span> is activated.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_setting_information_management"><a class="link" href="#_setting_information_management">4.5.7. Setting Information Management</a></h4>
