<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_logging_4"><a class="link" href="#_logging_4">Logging</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can edit the Session Server log settings.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The detailed contents of the settings are as follows.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Log Home</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 98. Log Home</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 50%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Item (* indicates required value)</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Notes</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Log Home(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Log Home path</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">When default is selected, it is set to the logs folder under the server installation directory, and when manually selected, you can enter the log directory home path in the Log Home Prefix field</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Retention Days(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Maximum retention days for logs</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default: 0 (unlimited)</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_environment_4"><a class="link" href="#_environment_4">Environment</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides a screen for managing Start Shell settings.
Modify using a file editor and click the <span class="button">Save button</span> to save.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Base Env ($CATALINA_HOME/env.sh) - Shell Script for starting Server</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>By default, settings are disabled for modification, but if you want to modify them,
click <span class="button">Settings button</span> in ADMIN > Manager Environment > Manager Configuration
to change the following settings to false.</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash">server.environment.envshell.readonly=false</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_server_log_viewer_3"><a class="link" href="#_server_log_viewer_3">4.5.8. Server Log Viewer</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can search for log file contents under the Log Home path of the target Server via the Log Viewer button on the right side of the Server list.</p>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock important">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-important" title="Important"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>To use this functionality, you must meet the following requirements.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>The Node to which the target Server belongs must be running.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Clicking the Log Viewer button on the Server list will allow you to check the directory and files based on the Log Home path of the target Server in a tree structure.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Selecting a file will allow you to view the file content, and when you first select it, you can check the file content up to a predetermined size from the end.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can view and check the content of log files in a predetermined size using Load More and Load Previous buttons.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>When there is no more content to search (e.g., at the beginning of the file), a message "No more data to read" will be displayed in Alert.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>If you use Load More and there is no more content to search (e.g., at the end of the file), a message "No more data to read" will be displayed at the bottom of the screen.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_memory_cache_server"><a class="link" href="#_memory_cache_server">4.6. Memory Cache Server</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides a screen for managing Memory Cache Server.
You can register, modify, and delete Memory Cache Servers installed on Nodes, and execute start and stop shells.</p>
</div>

<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="memory_cacher_server_install"><a class="link" href="#memory_cacher_server_install">4.6.2. Install</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Install button</span>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter Server ID, Service Port, and Mirror Server IP/Port.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span> to save.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>There may be differences between the information of Servers actually installed on Nodes and Servers managed by Manager. (When installing via console)</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If a Server ID duplication error occurs, use the Register function to check previously installed Server information.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_register_5"><a class="link" href="#_register_5">4.6.3. Register</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Register button</span>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click on the Server to register.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span> to save.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_modification_6"><a class="link" href="#_modification_6">4.6.4. Modification</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Edit(pencil) button</span> to change Server information to modifiable state.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Modify Server properties.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span> to save.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_deletion_6"><a class="link" href="#_deletion_6">4.6.5. Deletion</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Delete(trash can) button</span> to change Server information to deletable state.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Save button</span>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Press the <span class="button">OK button</span> to display a window for selecting deletion type.</p>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Deregister : Delete Server information only from Manager DB and maintain physical Server engine (can be re-registered later via <span class="button">Register button</span>)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Uninstall : Delete Server information from Manager DB and also delete physical Server engine</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic" start="4">
<li>
<p>When Uninstall is selected, a window asking to delete the log directory is displayed.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When the use Server Delete Protection value in the Manager Environment menu of ADMIN > Preference > Manager Environment is set to true,
Manager can prevent the server from being uninstalled.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="memory_cache_server_startstop"><a class="link" href="#memory_cache_server_startstop">4.6.6. Start/Stop</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Stop button</span> to stop the Server.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Start button</span> to start the Server.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Only when the Server is in a state where it can be started, the <span class="button">Start button</span> is activated.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_server_log_viewer_4"><a class="link" href="#_server_log_viewer_4">4.6.9. Server Log Viewer</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can search for log file contents under the Log Home path of the target Server via the Log Viewer button on the right side of the Server list.</p>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock important">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-important" title="Important"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>To use this functionality, you must meet the following requirements.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>The Node to which the target Server belongs must be running.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Clicking the Log Viewer button on the Server list will allow you to check the directory and files based on the Log Home path of the target Server in a tree structure.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Selecting a file will allow you to view the file content, and when you first select it, you can check the file content up to a predetermined size from the end.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can view and check the content of log files in a predetermined size using Load More and Load Previous buttons.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>When there is no more content to search (e.g., at the beginning of the file), a message "No more data to read" will be displayed in Alert.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>If you use Load More and there is no more content to search (e.g., at the end of the file), a message "No more data to read" will be displayed at the bottom of the screen.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect1">
<h2 id="_cluster"><a class="link" href="#_cluster">5. Cluster</a></h2>
<div class="sectionbody">
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_server_cluster"><a class="link" href="#_server_cluster">5.1. Server Cluster</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>A Server Cluster is a group of Application Servers and Web Servers that run with the same configuration to provide the same service.</p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/server_cluster_overview.png" alt="server cluster overview">
</div>
<div class="title">Figure 9. Server Cluster screen</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_server_cluster_list"><a class="link" href="#_server_cluster_list">5.1.1. Server Cluster List</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can view the list of Server Clusters registered in Manager by selecting Server Cluster from the left menu.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The properties provided in the Server Cluster List table are as follows.</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 112. Server Cluster properties</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 50%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Item</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Note</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Select</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Checkbox for deletion</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Server Cluster Name</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Cluster name</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Servers</p></td>

<p>The number of each Server type that composes the Server Cluster</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">

<li>
<p>WAS</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Web</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_create_server_cluster"><a class="link" href="#_create_server_cluster">5.1.2. Create Server Cluster</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When creating a Server Cluster, select the list of Application Servers and Web Servers that will compose the Server Cluster.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select a Server Cluster Group and click the <span class="button">+New</span> button at the bottom of the Server Cluster list to open the create screen.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter the basic information for the Server Cluster.</p>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Server Cluster Name: Enter the Server Cluster name.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>WAS type: Select the Application type to be used as a member of the Server Cluster. There are two types: Standard and Enterprise.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enable Scaling: Select whether to use Auto Scaling. This option cannot be changed after the server cluster is created. (This feature is supported only in the Container Edition and requires setting scaling.enable=true in manager.conf.)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Description: Enter necessary descriptions related to the Server Cluster.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic" start="3">
<li>
<p>The server list corresponding to the selected Application Server Type is displayed in the "Application servers in server cluster" area below.
Click a server in Selectable Servers, then click the <span class="button">>></span> button to move it to the Selected Servers area. Do the same in the "Web Servers in server cluster" area: click a server in Selectable Servers, then click the <span class="button">>></span> button to move it to Selected Servers.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>A server can be assigned to only one Server Cluster, so only Application Servers and Web Servers that are not mapped to other Server Clusters are listed in Selectable Servers.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>WAS instances with different Engine No. cannot compose a single Server Cluster.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic" start="4">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">V Save</span> button to save.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Verify that a menu item with the entered Server Cluster name has been added to the left tree.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_delete_server_cluster"><a class="link" href="#_delete_server_cluster">5.1.3. Delete Server Cluster</a></h4>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>In the left Server Cluster tree, select the Server Cluster Group.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>In the Server Cluster List, select the checkbox in the Select column for the Server Cluster you want to delete.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">- Delete</span> button to delete.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_server_cluster_details"><a class="link" href="#_server_cluster_details">5.1.4. Server Cluster Details</a></h4>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_overview_2"><a class="link" href="#_overview_2">Overview</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Select a Server Cluster from the left menu or the Server Cluster Group details to open the Overview screen for the Server Cluster.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The items and buttons in the Server Cluster details area provide the following functions.</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 113. Items and buttons in the Server Cluster details area</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 75%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Item or Button</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Function</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Server Cluster Name(*)</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Server Cluster name</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>WAS type(*)</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>The Application Server type configured in the Server Cluster (not changeable)</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Server Config Synchronization Policy</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Policy when an error occurs during Server Cluster synchronization (selecting the <span class="button">Sync</span> button)</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The options for Server Config Synchronization Policy are as follows (default: Force):</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Stop: Stop immediately when an error occurs during synchronization</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Rollback: Roll back everything when an error occurs during synchronization</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Force: Skip the server where the error occurred and continue with the next</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Enable Scaling</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Whether to use Auto Scaling for this Server Cluster (not changeable)</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Description</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Description of the Server Cluster</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="button">Compare</span></p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Compares the synchronization status of Application Servers, Web Servers, and Session Servers in the Server Cluster.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The comparison items by Server type are as follows, and they are displayed in the columns of each Server list area below.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Server Config, Application, Resource, and Session comparisons are based on the Master Server of each Server type.</p>
</div>
<div class="dlist">
<dl>
<dt class="hdlist1">Application Server</dt>
<dd>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Server Config: Whether Application Server configuration information is the same</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Application: Whether deployed applications are the same on each Application Server</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Resource: Whether resource settings are the same</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Session: Whether the Session Server settings for session clustering are the same</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</dd>
<dt class="hdlist1">Web Server</dt>
<dd>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Server Config: Whether Web Server configuration information is the same</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Connect to WAS: Whether it is linked to all Application Servers in the Server Cluster</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="button">Sync</span></p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Synchronizes the Server Config, Application, Resource, and Session information of Application Servers in the Server Cluster.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Also synchronizes the Server Config and WAS linkage information of Web Servers in the Server Cluster.</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="button">Snapshot</span></p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Saves the current state as a Snapshot for the synchronized Server Cluster. You can check the created Snapshot in the Snapshot tab.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The Snapshot includes Application Sources. Therefore, creating too many Snapshots can consume a lot of system disk space. Create Snapshots only when necessary and delete unnecessary Snapshots via the Snapshot tab.</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="button">Graceful Restart</span></p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Sequentially restarts Web Servers and Application Servers in the Server Cluster.
Since it performs a graceful stop, the server stops after all processing threads finish.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The procedure is as follows. Steps in parentheses are optional.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Web Server Stop</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Application Stop</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>(Upload Application Source)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Application Server Start</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>(Start Web Server in staging port for testing)</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Web Server Start</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="button">V Save</span></p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Saves changes to the Server Cluster details.</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="sect5">
<h6 id="_check_synchronization_status"><a class="link" href="#_check_synchronization_status">Check synchronization status</a></h6>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>To check the synchronization status of the Server Cluster, click the <span class="button">Compare</span> button, then view the results in the columns below each Server list.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If the state is the same or valid, the status is shown as <span class="icon">green circle icon</span>.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If server states differ, it is shown as <span class="icon">red circle icon</span>. Clicking the icon opens a popup window to see detailed information by Server.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can also click a Server Name in each list to navigate to that server’s detail screen.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Application Server Server Config details</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Comparison results of configuration files are displayed. Click the <span class="button">magnifier</span> button in the Detail column next to the file name to view detailed comparison results (last modified date, config file content) versus the Master server.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Application Server Application details</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Shows comparison results of application deploy status.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Application Server Resource details</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Shows comparison results of Application Server resources.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Application Server Session details</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Shows comparison results of Session settings. The popup provides the session information configured on the Master Server.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Web Server Server Config</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Shows comparison results of configuration files. Click the <span class="button">magnifier</span> button in the Detail column next to the file name to view detailed comparison results (last modified date, config file content) versus the Master server.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Web Server Connect to WAS</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When the Web Server is linked only to all Application Servers that belong to the Server Cluster, it is displayed as <span class="icon">green circle icon</span>. Otherwise, it is displayed as <span class="icon">red circle icon</span>.
Click the <span class="icon">red circle icon</span> to open a popup and check details.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The popup shows details on whether the Application Servers linked to the Web Server are all registered in the Server Cluster (Web Server Status). It also shows whether all Application Servers registered in the Server Cluster are linked to the Web Server (Application Server Status).</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect5">
<h6 id="_perform_state_synchronization"><a class="link" href="#_perform_state_synchronization">Perform state synchronization</a></h6>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>To perform synchronization for the Server Cluster, click the <span class="button">Sync</span> button. The results can be checked in the columns below each Server list.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect5">
<h6 id="_graceful_restart"><a class="link" href="#_graceful_restart">Graceful Restart</a></h6>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The Graceful Restart feature is used to restart all servers in the Server Cluster while ensuring that in-progress tasks complete. It proceeds as follows (applies to all servers in the Server Cluster):</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Before starting Graceful Restart</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click the Start Process button to begin the Graceful Restart.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Web Server Stop phase</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Stop the Web Server. It stops after all running threads finish.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Application Server Stop phase</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Stop the Application Server. This phase starts after all Web Servers have stopped.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Source deployment (optional) phase</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Deploy (upload) the application source to the Application Server. If you have a separate deployment system, this step is optional.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Application Server Start phase</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Start the Application Server. You can also view the startup logs.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Start Web Server in Staging mode (optional) phase</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Start the Web Server in Staging mode (optional). This allows testing on a staging port in an environment identical to production before opening to end users.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Web Server Start phase</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Start the Web Server in Staging mode (optional). This allows testing on a staging port in an environment identical to production before opening to end users.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Complete Graceful Restart</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_was_2"><a class="link" href="#_was_2">WAS</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>This tab manages the list of Application Servers in the Server Cluster and the items targeted for synchronization.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The detailed information for the server list at the top of the tab is the same as in Overview.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect5">
<h6 id="_synchronization_target_items"><a class="link" href="#_synchronization_target_items">Synchronization target items</a></h6>
<div class="sect6">
<h7 id="_manage_server_configuration_files"><a class="link" href="#_manage_server_configuration_files">Manage server configuration files</a></h7>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When you click the <span class="button">Config</span> button, a popup is provided where you can select the Master Server of Application Servers, specify the configuration files to synchronize, and choose whether to synchronize JDBC drivers.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Master Server</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Specify the Master Server among Application Servers in the Server Cluster.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Server Configs for Synchronization</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>This is the list of files to be kept identical across Application Servers in the Server Cluster. A basic list is registered when the Server Cluster is created, and you can add/remove files as needed for your project. The path is relative to the Application Server home.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Sync JDBC Drivers</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Choose whether to include all jar files under Manager Repository path /lib/datasource/ in the sync targets.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>To prevent runtime errors due to jar changes, JDBC drivers are synchronized only when the driver does not exist on the target server.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect6">
<h7 id="_manage_applications"><a class="link" href="#_manage_applications">Manage Applications</a></h7>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When you select a server from the Application Server list, you can view application details for the selected server via the Application tab at the bottom.
The screens and functions provided are the same as described in <a href="#WAS_Application_Settings">Application</a>. Therefore, detailed function descriptions are omitted here.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect6">
<h7 id="_manage_resources"><a class="link" href="#_manage_resources">Manage Resources</a></h7>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When you select a server from the Application Server list, you can view details of DataSource, JMS, and JTA for the selected server via the DataSource, JMS, and JTA tabs at the bottom.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The screens and functions provided are the same as described in <a href="#WAS_DataSource">Datasource</a>, <a href="#WAS_JMS">JMS</a>, and <a href="#WAS_JTA">JTA</a>. Therefore, detailed descriptions are omitted here.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect6">
<h7 id="_manage_session"><a class="link" href="#_manage_session">Manage Session</a></h7>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When you select a server from the Application Server list, you can view session details for the selected server via the Session tab at the bottom.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The screens and functions provided are the same as described in <a href="#WAS_session">Session</a>. Therefore, detailed descriptions are omitted here.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect5">
<h6 id="_manage_was_list"><a class="link" href="#_manage_was_list">Manage WAS list</a></h6>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Use the <span class="button">Clone</span>, <span class="button">Join</span>, or <span class="button">Unjoin</span> buttons to include or exclude Application Servers in the Server Cluster.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Clone</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click the <span class="button">Clone</span> button to install a new server with the same settings as the Master server and register it in the Server Cluster.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 114. Clone popup item descriptions</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 75%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Item</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Function</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Post Processing Options</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Cloned Server Start: Whether to start the server after clone</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>All Web Server Sync: Synchronize linkage with Web Servers after clone</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>All Web Server Graceful Restart: Whether to restart Web Servers after clone</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Node List</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Node where the cloned server will be installed</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Clone Server ID / Clone Service Port</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Enter the ID and Service Port for the cloned server</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Include External Source</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Select Y if the application source is located outside the server and you want to clone that source as well</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Join</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click the <span class="button">Join</span> button to add already created, registrable Application Servers to the Server Cluster.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Unjoin</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click the <span class="button">Unjoin</span> button to remove servers registered in the Cluster from the Cluster list.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect5">
<h6 id="_application_server_synchronization_and_comparison"><a class="link" href="#_application_server_synchronization_and_comparison">Application Server synchronization and comparison</a></h6>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Compare</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click the <span class="button">Compare</span> button to compare the synchronization status of Application Servers in the Server Cluster.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Sync</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click the <span class="button">Sync</span> button to synchronize Application Server Server Config, Application, Resource, and Session settings in the Server Cluster.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect5">
<h6 id="_rolling_restart"><a class="link" href="#_rolling_restart">Rolling Restart</a></h6>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Rolling Restart is used to sequentially restart Application Servers within a Server Cluster.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Since this feature is performed on target servers to be restarted, stopped servers are excluded.
Select the target servers from the server list and click the <span class="button">Rolling Restart</span> button to open the Rolling Restart popup.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>In the popup, before starting Rolling Restart, you can set the startup interval between servers and whether to Force Stop in the Execution option area.
In the Rolling Restart area, you can monitor the sequential restart status of the selected servers.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The Action column in the popup provides the <span class="button">Force Restart</span> and <span class="button">Next</span> buttons.</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 115. Rolling Restart popup item descriptions</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 33.3333%;">
<col style="width: 66.6667%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Node</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Node name where the server is installed</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Server</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Server name</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Server Status</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Current server run status</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Stop Status</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Server stop task status</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Start Status</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Server start task status</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Action</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">For a server being restarted, the <span class="button">Force Restart</span> and <span class="button">Next</span> buttons are provided.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Interval</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Remaining wait time for the server. Starts from the value set in Interval in the Execution Option area and counts down to 0, then proceeds to restart the next server.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Elapsed time</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Processing time for the restart</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 116. Rolling Restart popup buttons</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 75%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Button</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Function</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Start</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Starts restart for the target servers shown in the popup. It proceeds sequentially from the top of the table.</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Pause</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Pauses the restart job. If a stop/start is in progress, the current command is not interrupted; the next work is queued.</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Resume</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Resumes the restart job. Starts from after the last completed task before Pause.</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Force Restart</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>If stop does not complete normally, you can force stop and then start via this button.
Shown only until the server being restarted completes stopping.</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Next</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>If you want to proceed to the next server restart before the current server’s restart completes, click Next. Even if Next is performed, the previous servers' restart work continues.</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_web_server"><a class="link" href="#_web_server">Web Server</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>This tab manages the list of Web Servers in the Server Cluster and the items targeted for synchronization.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The detailed information for the server list at the top of the tab is the same as in Overview.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect5">
<h6 id="_synchronization_target_items_2"><a class="link" href="#_synchronization_target_items_2">Synchronization target items</a></h6>
<div class="sect6">
<h7 id="_manage_server_configuration_files_2"><a class="link" href="#_manage_server_configuration_files_2">Manage server configuration files</a></h7>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When you click the <span class="button">Config</span> button, a popup is provided where you can select the Master Server for Web Servers and set the list of configuration files to synchronize.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Master Server:</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Specify the Master Server among Web Servers in the Server Cluster.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Server Configs for Synchronization:</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>This is the list of files to be kept identical across Web Servers in the Server Cluster. A basic list is registered when the Server Cluster is created, and you can add/remove files as needed. The path is relative to the Web Server home.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect6">
<h7 id="_connector"><a class="link" href="#_connector">Connector</a></h7>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can view and modify detailed connector information for the Web Server.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When you select a server from the Web Server list, you can view connector details for the selected server via the Connector tab at the bottom.
The screens and functions provided are the same as described in <a href="#web_Connector">Connector</a>. Therefore, detailed descriptions are omitted here.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect5">
<h6 id="_manage_web_server_list"><a class="link" href="#_manage_web_server_list">Manage Web Server list</a></h6>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Use the <span class="button">Clone</span>, <span class="button">Join</span>, or <span class="button">Unjoin</span> buttons to include or exclude Web Servers in the Server Cluster.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Clone</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click the <span class="button">Clone</span> button to install a new server with the same settings as the Master server and register it in the Server Cluster.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 117. Clone popup item descriptions</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 75%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Item</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Function</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Post Processing Options</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Cloned Server Start: Whether to start the server after clone</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Node List</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Node where the cloned server will be installed</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Server ID / Clone Service Port</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Enter the ID and Service Port for the cloned server</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Include External Source</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Select Y if the source is outside the server and you want to clone that source as well</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Join</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click the <span class="button">Join</span> button to add already created, registrable Web Servers to the Server Cluster.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Unjoin</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click the <span class="button">Unjoin</span> button to remove servers registered in the Cluster from the Cluster list.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect5">
<h6 id="_web_server_synchronization_and_comparison"><a class="link" href="#_web_server_synchronization_and_comparison">Web Server synchronization and comparison</a></h6>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Compare</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click the <span class="button">Compare</span> button to compare the synchronization status of Web Servers in the Server Cluster.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Sync</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click the <span class="button">Sync</span> button to synchronize Web Server Server Config and Connect WAS in the Server Cluster.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When you click the Sync button for Web Server, it synchronizes Web Server settings and interconnects all Web Servers and WAS in the Server Cluster in a full-mesh structure.
If you want to synchronize only configuration without changing to a full-mesh structure, we recommend composing separate Server Clusters for Web Server and WAS respectively.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect5">
<h6 id="_rolling_restart_2"><a class="link" href="#_rolling_restart_2">Rolling Restart</a></h6>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Rolling Restart is used to sequentially restart Web Servers within a Server Cluster.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Since this feature is performed on target servers to be restarted, stopped servers are excluded.
Select the target servers from the server list and click the <span class="button">Rolling Restart</span> button to open the Rolling Restart popup.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>In the popup, before starting Rolling Restart, you can set the startup interval between servers and whether to Force Stop in the Execution option area.
In the Rolling Restart area, you can monitor the sequential restart status of the selected servers.</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 118. Rolling Restart popup item descriptions</caption>

<col style="width: 33.3333%;">
<col style="width: 66.6667%;">
</colgroup>

<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Node name where the server is installed</th>
</tr>
</thead>

</tr>
<tr>
