<div class="sect1">
<h2 id="_topology"><a class="link" href="#_topology">8. Topology</a></h2>
<div class="sectionbody">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can see the configuration status of each system at a glance, and it provides installation and configuration functions, as well as resource monitoring and start/stop control.</p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/topology_overview.png" alt="topology overview">
</div>
<div class="title">Figure 63. Topology Screen</div>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_screen_configuration"><a class="link" href="#_screen_configuration">8.1. Screen Configuration</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>It is divided into System area, Topology area, Resource monitoring area, and Service tracing area.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>System Area</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides a list of registered Systems in card format.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The icon to the left of the system name in the card represents the system status, which is displayed in 3 levels based on the Resources constituting the system and diagnostic results.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p><span class="icon">Blue circle icon</span> : When all servers constituting the system have Low resource usage and diagnostic processes are not performed</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span class="icon">Orange circle icon</span> : When all servers constituting the system have Middle or lower resource usage, or diagnostic process results are in Abnormal status</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span class="icon">Red circle icon</span> : When some servers constituting the system have High resource usage, or diagnostic process results are in Fault status</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The <span class="icon">clock icon</span> below the system name represents the average response time of WASs within the system, and the <span class="icon">user icon</span> represents the current number of users (in the last 5 minutes) / total users today.</p>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The criteria for Low, Middle, and High resource usage can be changed in DIAGNOSTICS > Policy > Common Rule Setting > Dashboard items.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Topology Area</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Shows the configuration status of nodes and server instances by system in topology chart format.
You can install and run Web Server, WAS, and Session Server installed on each Node, perform clustering, and check server status information. Additionally,
you can configure integration between Web Server-WAS, WAS-Session Server, and WAS-Datasource.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Resource Monitoring Area</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides detailed resource monitoring information such as CPU and Memory of Nodes and Servers.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Service Tracing Area</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can trace services based on specific Client IP and requested Service Pattern to check
the number of requests, average response time, and number of service response errors.</p>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Through the <span class="button">Settings button</span> on the right side of the system list, you can change the following items:</p>
</div>
<div class="dlist">
<dl>
<dt class="hdlist1">Chart</dt>
<dd>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Refresh Interval : Data retrieval cycle for the topology area</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Refresh Topology Chart : Metadata consistency verification and restoration for drawing charts in the topology area</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</dd>
<dt class="hdlist1">System List</dt>
<dd>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Selection of Systems to display in the System list and order change</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</dd>
<dt class="hdlist1">Elements</dt>
<dd>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Show Endpoint : Setting for displaying the Endpoint area</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Show Edge Info : Setting for displaying detailed information on Edges</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Show Server Name : Setting for displaying server names</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</dd>
<dt class="hdlist1">Transparency</dt>
<dd>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Node : Setting transparency for Nodes in the topology area</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Edge : Setting transparency for Edges in the topology area</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</dd>
</dl>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_topology_area_details"><a class="link" href="#_topology_area_details">8.2. Topology Area Details</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>In topology, information is displayed differently according to the view mode.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>View All : Shows all information.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Low : Shows only instances with Low resource usage on servers.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Middle : Shows only instances with Middle resource usage on servers.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>High : Shows only instances with High resource usage on servers.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Stop/unknown : Shows only stopped instances.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Also, instances are activated and displayed by Cluster unit.</p>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>For WAS with diagnostic functionality configured, the diagnostic results of server status (Abnormal or Fault) are checked first before checking resource usage.
If the status is determined to be in that state, it is displayed as High status.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_control_edit_off"><a class="link" href="#_control_edit_off">8.2.1. Control [Edit: OFF]</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides detailed monitoring information and control functions from Client to Database from an E2E (End to End) perspective.</p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/topology_control_edit_off.png" alt="topology control edit off">
</div>
<div class="title">Figure 64. Topology Control [Edit: OFF]</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_client_area"><a class="link" href="#_client_area">CLIENT Area</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Client refers to users, and you can check the browser screen rendering time when users make requests to the Web Server and the content of script errors.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_web_area"><a class="link" href="#_web_area">WEB Area</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The WEB area provides information about installed Web Nodes and Web servers and allows server control.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Configuration Information</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Web Node is the area where Web servers are installed, and you can check the server installation status by node.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Monitoring Information</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Web Node provides basic CPU, Memory, Disk status information by default.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When you hover over a Web Server, it provides CPU, Memory, Thread status information in a popup form.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When you select a Web Node and a Server, you can get real-time detailed monitoring information for each in the Resource Monitoring Area on the right side of the Topology Area.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Node : CPU, Memory, Disc, Network and basic information</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Server : CPU, Memory, Thread, QoS and basic information</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Control Functions</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Server provides three main control functions.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Server Control : Start, Stop, Service Control</p>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Service Control provides uninterrupted deployment functionality.
This is a method in which the source corrected for an error service is immediately deployed to the WAS and then the Web Server (timely server) that calls this WAS is configured to forward the error service to the timely server, thereby ensuring normal service provision.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>To use this function, the LSC module must be enabled in the Web Server (httpd-lsc.conf file, change LscEnable to On, and restart the server).</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>After defining the control time, control conditions (Header, Cookie, URL) and the server to forward (<a href="http://IP:Port" class="bare">http://IP:Port</a>) to save,
it connects incoming requests in real-time to the corresponding server according to the defined content, thereby providing service without server restart.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Move to : Configuration</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Cluster : Compare, Sync, Snapshot, Graceful Restart</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_application_area"><a class="link" href="#_application_area">APPLICATION Area</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>APPLICATION Area provides information about installed WAS Nodes and WAS servers and allows server control.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Configuration Information</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>WAS Node is the area where WAS servers are installed, and you can check the server installation status by node.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Monitoring Information</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>WAS Node provides basic CPU, Memory, Disk status information by default.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When you hover over a WAS Server, it provides CPU, Thread, Heap status information in a popup form.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When you select a WAS Node and a Server, you can get real-time detailed monitoring information for each in the Resource Monitoring Area on the right side of the Topology Area.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Node : CPU, Memory, Disc, Network and basic information</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Server : Warning, CPU, Memory, Thread, QoS and basic information</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Control Functions</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Server provides four main control functions.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Server Control : Start, Stop, Forced Stop</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Dump : Thread Dump, Active Service Dump, Heap Dump</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Move to : Configuration, Monitoring</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Cluster : Compare, Sync, Snapshot, Graceful Restart</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_session_area"><a class="link" href="#_session_area">SESSION Area</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>SESSION Area provides information about installed Session Nodes and Session servers and allows server control.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Configuration Information</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Session Node is the area where Session servers are installed, and you can check the server installation status by node.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Monitoring Information</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Session Node provides basic CPU, Memory, Disk status information by default.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When you hover over a Session Server, it provides CPU, Session Count, Heap status information in a popup form.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When you select a Session Node and a Server, you can get real-time detailed monitoring information for each in the Resource Monitoring Area on the right side of the Topology Area.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Node : CPU, Memory, Disc, Network and basic information</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Server : CPU, Memory, Session Count and basic information</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Control Functions</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Server provides two main control functions.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Server Control : Start, Stop</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Move to : Configuration</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_db_area"><a class="link" href="#_db_area">DB Area</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>DB Area provides information about the Database connected to WAS. The Database must be registered in the RESOURCE menu.
Nodes are represented as virtual nodes to be consistent with other areas.
Monitoring and control functions for each DB are not provided.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_edge_information"><a class="link" href="#_edge_information">Edge Information</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The connection line means the connection between instances, or between an instance and a Database, and represents the average response time of the server and the number of connected connections.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Client-WEB : Connection count (Average browser rendering completion time (ms)/Average Web Server response time (ms))</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>WEB-APPLICATION : Active Connection count (Average WAS response time (ms))</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>APPLICATION-DB : Active Datasource usage rate (%)</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>End to End monitoring functionality is set to off by default.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Therefore, to view the average browser rendering response time between Client-WEB or the average response time of the server, you must set it in the following order:</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>manager.conf file, set diagnostics.e2e.enable=true</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>In the httpd.conf file of the Web Server, uncomment httpd-eum.conf</p>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code><IfDefine MOD_EUM>
 #LENA E2E Monitoring Extension settings
 Include ${INSTALL_PATH}/conf/extra/httpd-eum.conf <-- Uncomment this line
</IfDefine></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Web Server’s eum/eum.properties file, modify agent_enable value to true</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>However, this function is not supported on window OS.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_control_edit_on"><a class="link" href="#_control_edit_on">8.2.2. Control [Edit: ON]</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When you select the <span class="button">Edit button</span> in the upper right corner of the Topology Area, it switches to the editing mode. Here, you can provide node and instance installation functions within the system.</p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/topology_control_edit_on.png" alt="topology control edit on">
</div>
<div class="title">Figure 65. Topology Control [Edit: ON]</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_node"><a class="link" href="#_node">Node</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The installation/modification/deletion operation of the Node is the same as <a href="#server_node">Node</a>, so only the usage method is described here.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Installation</p>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the <span class="button">Node button</span> and click on the area you want to install above.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter the corresponding information in the detailed information area on the right side of the screen.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select the <span class="button">Save button</span> .</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Modification</p>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the node you want to change.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Change the corresponding information in the detailed information area on the right side of the screen.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select the <span class="button">Save button</span> .</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Deletion</p>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the node you want to delete.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Right-click and select Hide, Unregister, Uninstall from the menu.</p>
<div class="admonitionblock important">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-important" title="Important"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When deleting a Node, there must be no servers installed in the Node.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_instance"><a class="link" href="#_instance">Instance</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The installation/modification/deletion operation of the Server is the same as <a href="#server_server">server</a>, so only the usage method is described here.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Installation</p>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the <span class="button">Instance button</span> and click on the Node above the area you want to install.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter the corresponding information in the detailed information area on the right side of the screen.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select the <span class="button">Save button</span> .</p>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The list of Nodes with no servers installed in each area is provided in the gray background below the area, as a square button.
If you want to install a server in an empty node, double-click the node button.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Modification</p>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the server you want to change.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Change the corresponding information in the detailed information area on the right side of the screen.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select the <span class="button">Save button</span> .</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Deletion</p>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the server you want to delete.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Right-click and select Unregister, Delete from the menu.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_edge"><a class="link" href="#_edge">Edge</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Edge means the connection between servers, and you can connect servers within the WEB-APPLICATION, APPLICATION-SESSION, APPLICATION-DB areas.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Connection</p>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the <span class="button">Edge button</span> and drag from the starting server you want to connect to the destination server.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter the corresponding information in the detailed information area on the right side of the screen.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select the <span class="button">Save button</span> .</p>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When connecting between APPLICATION-SESSION, the solid line means the Primary Server, and the dotted line means the Secondary Server.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Change Connection Information</p>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the edge you want to change.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Change the corresponding information in the detailed information area on the right side of the screen.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select the <span class="button">Save button</span> .</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Disconnection</p>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the edge you want to delete.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select the Delete button in the menu of the right-click button.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_cluster_2"><a class="link" href="#_cluster_2">Cluster</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can set up Server Cluster functionality provided by the CLUSTER menu.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Creation</p>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the <span class="button">Cluster button</span> .</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter the corresponding information in the detailed information area on the right side of the screen.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select the <span class="button">Save button</span> .</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Change</p>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the server cluster you want to change in the select box next to the <span class="button">Cluster button</span> .</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Change the corresponding information in the detailed information area on the right side of the screen.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select the <span class="button">Save button</span> .</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Deletion</p>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the server cluster you want to change in the select box next to the <span class="button">Cluster button</span> .</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select the <span class="button">Delete button</span> in the detailed information area on the right side of the screen.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_service_tracing_area_details"><a class="link" href="#_service_tracing_area_details">8.3. Service Tracing Area Details</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>After entering a specific server’s IP or Service Pattern and selecting the <span class="button">Start button</span>, you can trace services based on the entered information to check the number of requests and errors.
During tracing, Xlog information is also provided on the right side of the service tracing area, so you can select xlog as needed to check detailed information.</p>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>To use the service tracing functionality, you must configure the following in order:</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Set diagnostics.e2e.enable=true in the manager.conf file</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Uncomment the httpd-eum.conf file in the httpd.conf file of the tracing target Web Server</p>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code><IfDefine MOD_EUM>
 #LENA E2E Monitoring Extension settings
 Include ${INSTALL_PATH}/conf/extra/httpd-eum.conf <-- Uncomment this part
</IfDefine></code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Modify the agent_enable value to true in the eum/eum.properties file of the tracing target Web Server</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Modify the enable.send.profile.info value to true in the advertiser.conf file of the tracing target WAS</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Note: This functionality is not supported on Windows OS.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect1">
<h2 id="_admin"><a class="link" href="#_admin">9. Admin</a></h2>
<div class="sectionbody">
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_iam"><a class="link" href="#_iam">9.1. IAM</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides user management and per-user menu permission management for Manager.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_users_user_management"><a class="link" href="#_users_user_management">9.1.1. Users (User Management)</a></h4>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_user_list"><a class="link" href="#_user_list">User List</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>From ADMIN > Users, you can create, edit, and delete Manager users.</p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/admin_users.png" alt="admin users">
</div>
<div class="title">Figure 66. Users screen</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The user management fields are as follows.</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 164. User management fields</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 50%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Field (* = required)</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Note</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Use ID(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">User identifier</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">User Name(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">User name</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Password(*)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">User password</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Must be at least 8 characters with a mix of special characters, numbers, and letters</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Change User ID</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Who created/updated the user data</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Last Update</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">When the user data was created/updated</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock"><span class="icon">+ icon</span></p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Indicates that the selected permission info is being changed when clicking <span class="button">New</span> or <span class="button">Edit</span></p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock"><span class="icon">- icon</span></p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Indicates that the selected permission info is marked for deletion when clicking <span class="button">Delete</span></p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Two administrator accounts are provided by default (for emergency use).
We recommend adding additional users besides the provided accounts.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_create_user"><a class="link" href="#_create_user">Create User</a></h5>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">New</span> button to prepare to register a new user.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter user ID, user name, and user password.</p>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>The user password is stored in encrypted form.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Password must be 8–20 characters and include upper/lowercase letters, numbers, and special characters (!@#$%^*+=-).</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click <span class="button">Save</span> to store the user information.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Password encryption uses the SHA-512 hash algorithm.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_edit_user"><a class="link" href="#_edit_user">Edit User</a></h5>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the user to edit.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click <span class="button">Edit</span> to change the user name and user password.</p>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>The user password is stored in encrypted form.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click <span class="button">Save</span> to store the user information.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>If login fails 7 or more times, the account is locked and cannot be used.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>To unlock, change the password for the account from the user management screen.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>If there is no account currently logged in to Manager to change the password, run $LENA_HOME/bin/reset-manager-pw.sh to change it.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_delete_user"><a class="link" href="#_delete_user">Delete User</a></h5>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the user to delete.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click <span class="button">Delete</span> to mark the user as deletable.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click <span class="button">Save</span> to store the changes.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If only one user remains, that user cannot be deleted.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_auths_permission_management"><a class="link" href="#_auths_permission_management">9.1.2. Auths (Permission Management)</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>To manage permissions per menu, you must create permission groups.
From ADMIN > Auths you can create, edit, and delete permission groups.</p>
</div>

<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_create_permission"><a class="link" href="#_create_permission">Create Permission</a></h5>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">New</span> button to prepare to register a new permission.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter permission ID, permission name, and description.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click <span class="button">Save</span> to store the permission information.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_edit_permission"><a class="link" href="#_edit_permission">Edit Permission</a></h5>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the permission to edit.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click <span class="button">Edit</span> to change the permission name and description.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click <span class="button">Save</span> to store the permission information.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_delete_permission"><a class="link" href="#_delete_permission">Delete Permission</a></h5>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the permission to delete.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click <span class="button">Delete</span> to mark the permission as deletable.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click <span class="button">Save</span> to store the changes.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_user_auth_mapping_user_permission_management"><a class="link" href="#_user_auth_mapping_user_permission_management">9.1.3. User-Auth Mapping (User Permission Management)</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Manager users must belong to at least one group to gain menu usage permissions.
Administrators can select permission groups and assign users.
Select one of the registered permissions from the "Permission Management" screen and use the shuffle buttons to control user permissions.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_view_user_permissions"><a class="link" href="#_view_user_permissions">View User Permissions</a></h5>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">

</div>
<div class="title">Figure 68. User-Auth Mapping screen</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">

</div>

<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_map_user_permissions"><a class="link" href="#_map_user_permissions">Map User Permissions</a></h5>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the permission to which users will be assigned.</p>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>When you select a permission, both selectable users and currently selected users are displayed.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select the selectable users.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Assign or remove users.</p>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Single right shuffle</span> to assign the selected users.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">All right shuffle</span> to assign all users.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Single left shuffle</span> to remove the selected users.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">All left shuffle</span> to remove all users.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click <span class="button">Save</span> to store user-permission mapping information.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_menu_auth_mapping_menu_permission_management"><a class="link" href="#_menu_auth_mapping_menu_permission_management">9.1.4. Menu-Auth Mapping (Menu Permission Management)</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can configure accessible menus for each permission created in LENA Manager.
Select one permission to configure menus for from the created permissions.
From the list of all menus registered in LENA Manager, select the menus to control access for and set the menu permissions.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_view_menu_permissions"><a class="link" href="#_view_menu_permissions">View Menu Permissions</a></h5>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/admin_menu_auth_mapping.png" alt="admin menu auth mapping">
</div>
<div class="title">Figure 69. Menu-Auth Mapping screen</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The fields for menu permission management are as follows.</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 167. Fields for menu permission management</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 50%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Field</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Note</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Select Permission Name</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Combo box listing permissions registered via the "Permission Management" screen</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Menu Name</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Name of the menu selected from the left menu list registered in LENA Manager</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Auth</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Whether the selected permission can access the menu</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Default "N"</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When Node, Server, or Resource items are added from the submenus of "SERVER", "CLUSTER", "RESOURCE",
those items are automatically added and shown in the menu list of the "Menu Permission Management" screen.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Therefore, to add a new menu, register and create each item from the submenus under "SERVER", "CLUSTER", and "RESOURCE".</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When changing permissions for a Server, reflect the same permissions in the menus below.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>The Server under "SERVER"</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>The Server under "CLUSTER"</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Consider the case where, contrary to the recommendation, you configure permissions differently for some Server menus under a Server Cluster:</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Server under "SERVER": permission granted</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Server under "CLUSTER": permission not granted</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>In this case, menu/Server Cluster/Server permissions are represented as follows.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Number of Servers composing the Server Cluster: count of Servers with permission based on the "CLUSTER" submenus</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Submenus under the Server Cluster: only Servers with permission based on the "CLUSTER" submenus are shown</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Server list in the Server Cluster’s Overview, Application Server, and Web Server tabs: shows all Servers regardless of "CLUSTER" submenu permissions, since it must reflect the composition of the Server Cluster</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Server detail links in the Server Cluster’s Overview, Application Server, and Web Server tabs: since this is access to individual Servers, access is blocked for Servers without permission under the "SERVER" menu</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_map_menu_permissions"><a class="link" href="#_map_menu_permissions">Map Menu Permissions</a></h5>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Select the menu for which to configure permissions.</p>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>When a permission is selected, permissions for the menu are also retrieved.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select the menu to configure from the menu list.</p>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>When a menu is selected, menu permissions are displayed in the permissions list.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select Y or N to change permissions if needed.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click <span class="button">Save</span> to store the menu permission information.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect2">

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Contract Instance Limit</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Maximum number of contracted instances</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Instance Limit</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Actual measured number of instances</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Status</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Whether the license is valid</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>A notification is provided starting 15 days before license expiration.
You can check notifications from the <span class="icon">bell icon</span> at the top-right of the Manager.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_uploadrestore_license"><a class="link" href="#_uploadrestore_license">9.2.3. Upload/Restore License</a></h4>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_upload"><a class="link" href="#_upload">Upload</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Select the node(s) to which you want to apply a new License from the node list and click the <span class="button">Upload</span> button at the bottom.
Clicking the button opens the License Upload popup. Select the issued License file and upload it to apply the License to the selected nodes.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_restore"><a class="link" href="#_restore">Restore</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Select the node(s) whose License you want to restore from the node list and click the <span class="button">Restore</span> button at the bottom.
Clicking the button restores the License from the backed-up file.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_check_system_information_related_to_license"><a class="link" href="#_check_system_information_related_to_license">9.2.4. Check System Information related to License</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>In the License list screen, select a Node and click the <span class="button">Check System Info</span> button
to view system information required for issuing a License.</p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/admin_license_system_info_ui.png" alt="admin license system info ui">
</div>
<div class="title">Figure 71. System Information</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>A shell script is also provided in the CLI environment to view License status per Node.
The shell file is ${LENA_HOME}/bin/check-license.sh.
An example result from running this script is shown below.</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">

j0+iq30ABfJoyAhY3nWBVJhBy7h0U3hzJWr1hyCuZMFAHquL4dinwWAqmJeL+jntJKFufD38vdF2YwKEoRNH9dGQnqXZHO
U8wQZmN4UHk5YB5/O6YIUfFNGU3wyzjfKCfF9Golu9zQAsSZ358ptjC/TBUy+ccvLa75H32XPxiNSSxytn0hGFbcVc61kv

<div class="paragraph">
<p>The fields printed are the same as described above and provide basic information required for license issuance, which can be used when requesting a license.</p>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">

<tr>
<td class="icon">

</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Among the output fields, "HyperThreading" checks whether HyperThreading is used.
If HyperThreading is enabled, the number of cores is counted as double the number of physical cores.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_host_based_license_check_setting"><a class="link" href="#_host_based_license_check_setting">9.2.5. Host-based License Check Setting</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Depending on the contract, the License checks the target H/W by MAC Address or Host name.
The default setting is based on MAC Address. To perform license checks based on Host name (on Linux/Unix OS),
open the following files located under ${LENA_HOME}/bin and in each Application Server’s setenv.sh and modify as below.</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="title">start-agent.sh settings (add to $JAVA_OPTS)</div>
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash">JAVA_OPTS="${JAVA_OPTS} -Dlicense.check-type=hostname"</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="title">check-license.sh settings (uncomment the following)</div>
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash">_JAVA_OPTS="${_JAVA_OPTS} -Dlicense.check-type=hostname"</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="title">Each Application Server’s setenv.sh settings (uncomment the following)</div>
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash">CATALINA_OPTS=" ${CATALINA_OPTS} -Dlicense.check-type=hostname"</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_time_information"><a class="link" href="#_time_information">9.2.6. Time Information</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>In the license list, select the node(s) for which you want to check time information and click the <span class="button">Check Time Info</span> button to view time and timezone information for the selected nodes.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_security_service_control"><a class="link" href="#_security_service_control">9.3. Security (Service Control)</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>This feature restricts user requests to Application Servers based on IP or URL.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_rule_setting"><a class="link" href="#_rule_setting">9.3.1. Rule Setting</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If you want to control requests from specific IPs or URLs, configure a new Rule via the screen.
For convenience in adding and deleting Rules, a search function is provided.
Server-wide properties that apply to all Applications can be handled via an error page.</p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/admin_service_control_rule_setting.png" alt="admin service control rule setting">
</div>
<div class="title">Figure 72. Rule Setting screen</div>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The Use column in the Rule list indicates whether the Rule is applied to the Application Server.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When adding a Rule, the configurable fields are as follows.</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">

<div class="paragraph">
<p>If you apply a Rule of type "IP with DateTime" to an Application Server behind a Proxy Server,
Rule application may fail because, due to the security characteristics of the Proxy Server, the user’s IP may not be obtainable.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">

<p>Applied Rules cannot be deleted.</p>
</div>

</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_rule_applying"><a class="link" href="#_rule_applying">9.3.2. Rule Applying</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Select one of the added Rules to apply it to an Application Server.
For convenience, search is provided by Rule type, application unit, and Rule name.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Select a Rule from the list, then in Rule Applying use the <span class="button">shuffle buttons</span> to choose targets,
then click the <span class="button">On/Off</span> button to apply and save.
To exclude a target, use the <span class="button">shuffle buttons</span> to remove it from the applied list.</p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/admin_service_control_rule_applying.png" alt="admin service control rule applying">
</div>
<div class="title">Figure 73. Rule Applying screen</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The fields used in the Rule status and application screen are similar to those in the Rule Setting screen, with the following additional fields.</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 170. Additional fields</caption>

<p>When a new target is added to the selected Rule, depending on the application unit, entries are added to server.xml or context.xml.
When a target is excluded, the Rule settings added to the above configuration files are removed.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_service_control_log_view_rule_application_results"><a class="link" href="#_service_control_log_view_rule_application_results">9.3.3. Service Control Log (View Rule Application Results)</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Processing results for items to which Rules have been applied are displayed as a list.
For convenience, search is provided by Rule type, application unit, Rule name, and log time.</p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/admin_service_control_log.png" alt="admin service control log">
</div>
<div class="title">Figure 74. Service Control Log screen</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The fields used in the processing list are as follows.</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 171. Log information fields</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 50%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Field</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Note</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Controlled Date</p></td>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>

<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">HTTP Method</p></td>

<tr>

<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">

</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>For Rule history, set the access filter log aggregation listener to true in Manager’s /conf/manager.conf.
Logs are written to access_filter.log."date".txt in each server’s logs folder,
and Manager periodically aggregates each server’s logs into the Database.
(At this time, the aggregated logs are backed up to access_filter_log."date".txt.gathered.)
Logs aggregated into the Database can be viewed in the processing list screen.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>An example of the settings in the manager.conf file is shown below.</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash"># Whether to use the access filter log aggregation listener and its interval (seconds). Defaults: false, 60
accessfilter.listener=false
accessfilter.interval=60</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_notification_settings"><a class="link" href="#_notification_settings">9.4. Notification Settings</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can configure the Notifications shown in Manager and the SNS information to integrate those Notifications.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_manager_notification"><a class="link" href="#_manager_notification">9.4.1. Manager Notification</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When you open the Manager Notification menu, you can see which Notifications are currently enabled. Levels are categorized as Critical, Warning, and Info.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If you uncheck a Notification and click Save, that Notification will not be shown in the bell icon even when it occurs.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Notifications not shown in the icon can still be viewed by clicking the bell icon and then clicking the Notification Detail button at the top-right of the popup.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_sns_notification"><a class="link" href="#_sns_notification">9.4.2. SNS Notification</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can manage SNS integration information for Notifications generated by the Manager.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>It works based on WebHook, and integration can be configured per System.</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 172. Details for the SNS integration target</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 50%;">
<col style="width: 50%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Item</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>

<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">DuplicateTime(s)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">If the same Notification occurs repeatedly within DuplicateTime(s), it will not be sent to SNS.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Request</p></td>

<tr>

</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Webhook URL</p></td>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">SSL</p></td>

</table>

</colgroup>

<div class="paragraph">
<p>After entering the configuration fields, you can use the Test button to check whether the request works correctly.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If the test succeeds, save the configuration and toggle the on/off switch to on to enable the integration.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="admin_patch"><a class="link" href="#admin_patch">9.5. Patch</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides patches for feature improvements and bug fixes for installed LENA.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Patches are provided as compressed files and run as an independent Java process.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Patch operations can be executed via CLI and Management UI. If any service issues occur during patching, you can restore the previous state via the Restore function.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The patch order is as follows.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Upload patch file</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Apply Manager patch</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Apply Node patch</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Apply Server (Application Server, Session Server) patch</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Commit patch</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The restore order is as follows.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Restore Server patch</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Restore Node patch</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Restore Manager patch</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Commit restore</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>For CLI-based patching, see the Appendix.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_overview_4"><a class="link" href="#_overview_4">9.5.1. Overview</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides patch file upload and shows the patch reflection status for Manager and each Node’s Node Agent.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_upload_patch_file"><a class="link" href="#_upload_patch_file">Upload Patch File</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The Patch Info area displays details of the highest version among the patch files uploaded to the Manager.</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 174. Patch Info fields</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 50%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Field</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Note</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Patch File Ver.</p></td>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Patch Note</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Click the <span class="button">Detail(Note)</span> button
to view the detailed patch notes.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Shows patch note popup</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The process to upload a patch file is as follows.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Upload</span> button.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>After checking whether patching is possible, if normal, a popup for uploading the patch file is displayed</p>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="title">Patch-possible conditions</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>All Nodes registered in Manager must be running.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>patch must be in the committed state.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Node and server versions must match the manager version.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>No servers unregistered from Manager must exist.</p>
<div class="olist loweralpha">
<ol class="loweralpha" type="a">
<li>
<p>If there are unregistered servers, register them to Manager</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>If servers exist under the servers folder in the node engine, delete the corresponding folders</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select the patch file to upload; the upload will start automatically.</p>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Uploadable files are zip and tar.gz. Uploading other file types will display an error message.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_manager_patch"><a class="link" href="#_manager_patch">Manager Patch</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The Manager Info area shows the Manager’s patch status and allows you to execute patching and restoring of the Manager.</p>

<div class="sect5">
<h6 id="_patch"><a class="link" href="#_patch">Patch</a></h6>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click the <span class="button">Patch</span> button at the bottom of the Manager Info area to apply the latest patch.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Items described in Handwork are manual steps required after patch execution, so you must execute and reflect them. After completing Handwork, uncheck the checkbox at the bottom of the popup,
and the <span class="button">Handwork</span> button in the Manager Patch Info screen will change to white.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>After applying the Manager patch, until you click <span class="button">Commit</span> after applying patches to Nodes and Servers, you cannot perform operations such as installing/registering Nodes or installing/registering/duplicating Servers.</p>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>After patching, be sure to clear the browser cache to use the Manager of the patched version.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect5">
<h6 id="_restore_2"><a class="link" href="#_restore_2">Restore</a></h6>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click the <span class="button">Restore</span> button at the bottom of the Manager Info area to revert to the previous version before the patch.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Restoring is performed when the patch status of all nodes registered with Manager is Patch Available.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect5">
<h6 id="_commit"><a class="link" href="#_commit">Commit</a></h6>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>After applying all patches for Manager, Nodes, and Servers, click the <span class="button">Commit</span> button to finalize. After confirmation, you cannot revert to the previous version.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>

</td>

</div>

<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_patch_2"><a class="link" href="#_patch_2">Patch</a></h5>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Before applying the patch, ensure the server is stopped (<span class="button">Start</span> button enabled). If not stopped,
click the <span class="button">Stop</span> button to stop the server.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Check the checkbox(es) for the server(s) to patch (multiple selection allowed).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Patch</span> button to proceed. A log popup appears.
If manual steps are required after patch completion, the <span class="button">Handwork (wrench)</span> button in the Handwork column is shown in red.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>After closing the log popup, the server’s patch status icon changes to
<span class="icon">sun icon</span>, and current ver. and patch ver. display the applied patch version and N/A respectively.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Validation</p>
<div class="olist loweralpha">
<ol class="loweralpha" type="a">
<li>
<p>Cannot apply a patch when the server is running</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Cannot re-apply a patch to a server that already has the latest patch</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When applying a patch to a server for the first time for that Node, the Node patch is performed internally first, followed by the server patch.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
</div>

click the <span class="button">Stop</span> button to stop the server.</p>

<li>
<p>Check the checkbox(es) for the server(s) to restore (multiple selection allowed).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <span class="button">Restore</span> button to proceed. A log popup appears.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>After closing the log popup, the server’s patch status icon changes to
<span class="icon">cloud icon</span>, and current ver. and patch ver. display the previous version and the patch file version respectively.</p>
</li>

<div class="olist loweralpha">
<ol class="loweralpha" type="a">
<li>
<p>Cannot apply restore when the server is running</p>

</ol>

<h3 id="_preferences"><a class="link" href="#_preferences">9.6. Preferences</a></h3>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_action_trace"><a class="link" href="#_action_trace">9.6.1. Action Trace</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The history of add/modify/delete operations performed by each user through Manager is recorded in logs.
Action Trace provides functions to query/trace these histories.</p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">

</div>

<div class="paragraph">

<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_manager_environment"><a class="link" href="#_manager_environment">9.6.3. Manager Environment</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Provides information for Manager environment settings.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_manager_environment_2"><a class="link" href="#_manager_environment_2">Manager Environment</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Among Manager environment settings, provides information saved to env-manager.sh/bat.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Manager Allow IPs: Set IPs allowed to access Manager.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Java Home Path: Set the java home path used by Manager.</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_manager_configuration"><a class="link" href="#_manager_configuration">Manager Configuration</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Among Manager environment settings, provides information saved to manager.conf.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Two items are provided by default:</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>use JMX for Server Status: Whether to retrieve server status via JMX (default: false)</p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>

<p>Browsers that can be used with Manager features are Chrome/Edge (version 70 or higher) and Firefox (version 62 or higher). Some features may not work properly in IE, so other browsers are recommended.
The recommended minimum browser size is 1680×900.</p>
</div>

<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_manager_db_file_backup"><a class="link" href="#_manager_db_file_backup">10.4. Manager DB File Backup</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>HSQL DB files for managing Manager’s internal data are backed up periodically (daily).
The backup location is ${LENA_HOME}/repository/backup/database.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>By default, backup information older than 30 days is deleted. If you want to change the retention period,
open the manager.conf file under ${LENA_HOME}/repository/conf and set dbbackup.size=<retention_days>, then restart Manager to apply.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_deleting_manager_internal_history"><a class="link" href="#_deleting_manager_internal_history">10.5. Deleting Manager Internal History</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Manager periodically deletes internal histories via scheduling.
The data deleted are Action Trace history and Server History.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>By default, Action Trace history is retained for 30 days and Server History for 90 days.
If you want to change these retention periods, open the manager.conf file under ${LENA_HOME}/repository/conf and set
actiontrace.size=<retention_days>, serverhistory.size=<retention_days>, then restart Manager to apply.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_initialize_manager_admin_password"><a class="link" href="#_initialize_manager_admin_password">10.6. Initialize Manager admin Password</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If the Manager admin user password is lost or the number of failed password attempts is exceeded,
you need to initialize the password via console.</p>
</div>
<div class="olist arabic">
<ol class="arabic">
<li>
<p>Access the machine where Manager is installed via console (telnet or ssh).</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Run $LENA_HOME/bin/reset_manager_pw.sh.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter admin as the user whose password will be reset.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter the new password. The password must be at least 8 characters and be a combination of letters/numbers/special characters.
For security, the password is not displayed on the console.</p>
</li>
</ol>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash">[bin]$ ./reset-manager-pw.sh

 *******************************
* LENA Server Install ! *
 *******************************

+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
| 1. USER_ID is the user id to reset
| ex : admin
| 2. NEW_PASSWORD is the password to change
| - password rule #1 : more than 8 length
| - password rule #2 : inclusion of one or more alphabet characters
| - password rule #3 : inclusion of one or more numerical digits
| - password rule #4 : inclusion of one or more special characters
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Input USER_ID for installation. (q:quit)
administrator

Input NEW_PASSWORD for installation. (q:quit)

The password has been changed successfully.

Execution is completed.!!</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_recommended_os_parameters_for_lena_installation_centos"><a class="link" href="#_recommended_os_parameters_for_lena_installation_centos">10.7. Recommended OS Parameters for LENA Installation (CentOS)</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When installing LENA, it is recommended to set the OS parameter max user processes to 8192 or more.</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 50%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">parameter</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Recommended</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Default</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">max user processes</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">8192<br></p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">1024</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">open files</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">8192<br></p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">1024</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>On CentOS, you can check the max user processes setting by running the command 'ulimit -a' as follows.</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash">$ ulimit -a
core file size (blocks, -c) 0
data seg size (kbytes, -d) unlimited
scheduling priority (-e) 0
file size (blocks, -f) 8192
pending signals (-i) 14891
max locked memory (kbytes, -l) 64
max memory size (kbytes, -m) unlimited
open files (-n) 1024
pipe size (512 bytes, -p) 8
POSIX message queues (bytes, -q) 819200
real-time priority (-r) 0
stack size (kbytes, -s) 10240
cpu time (seconds, -t) unlimited
*max user processes (-u) 1024*
virtual memory (kbytes, -v) unlimited
file locks (-x) unlimited</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>On CentOS, you can set the number of processes and open files with 'ulimit -u' and 'ulimit -n'.
To persist these changes, add the ulimit commands to each user’s profile (.profile, .bash_profile),
or enforce via system configuration (CentOS).</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash">*$ cat $HOME/.bash_profile

*.. (omitted)*

*ulimit -u 8192

*ulimit -n 8192</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Another way is to open /etc/security/limits.conf (CentOS) and set the maximum number of processes (nproc) and open files (nofile).</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash">*$ cat /etc/security/limits.conf

*.. (omitted)*

** soft nproc 8192

** hard nproc 8192

** soft nofile 8192

** hard nofile 8192</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_patch_cli_command_line_interface"><a class="link" href="#_patch_cli_command_line_interface">10.9. Patch CLI (Command Line Interface)</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Patch is provided to deliver feature improvements and bug fixes for installed LENA.
It is provided as a compressed file and runs as an independent Java process.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>For the UI-based method, see <a href="#admin_patch">patch</a>.
This section describes how to patch and restore via the CLI.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_upload_and_extract_patch_files"><a class="link" href="#_upload_and_extract_patch_files">10.9.1. Upload and Extract Patch Files</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Upload the delivered patch files individually to the server where LENA is installed (e.g., via FTP).</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Extract the uploaded file at the following locations and rename the directory to the patch version.
When uploaded via Manager, extraction to these paths is performed automatically.</p>
</div>
<div class="literalblock">
<div class="content">
<pre>Node/Server patch file path: /engn001/lena/1.3/etc/patch/{patch-version}
Manager patch file path: /engn001/lena/1.3/repository/patch/{patch-version}</pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_patch_4"><a class="link" href="#_patch_4">10.9.2. Patch</a></h4>

<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_dbcp_add_on_features"><a class="link" href="#_dbcp_add_on_features">10.10. DBCP Add-on Features</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Control the Application Server via database connection tests, or generate logs of tasks performed by DBCP.</p>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Configure via environment variables or JVM options; JVM options take precedence.<br>
(If the same option is set in both, the JVM option value is used.)</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock note">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-note" title="Note"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When the Application Server is registered as a Windows service, configuration is only possible via JVM options.</p>
</div>
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_application_server_control"><a class="link" href="#_application_server_control">10.10.1. Application Server Control</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When an abnormal state is detected at Application Server startup, such as database connection failure, pool creation failure, or validation query failure, the server is shut down.</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 187. DBCP add-on, Application Server control</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 22.2222%;">
<col style="width: 22.2222%;">
<col style="width: 44.4444%;">
<col style="width: 11.1112%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Environment Variable</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">JVM Option</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Default</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">SHUTDOWN_IF_DBCONN_FAIL</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">lena.shutdownIfDbConnFail</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">If true, shut down the server on Database connection / Pool creation failure / validation query failure</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">false</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_dbcp_logging"><a class="link" href="#_dbcp_logging">10.10.2. DBCP Logging</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Logging for Datasource creation, Connection creation, Validation query execution, Borrow Connection, Return Connection / Detailed Stack Trace logging</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Environment Variable</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">JVM Option</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Default</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">DBCPLOG_ON</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">lena.dbcplogOn</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">If true, log when Datasource/Connection are created</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">false</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">DBCPLOG_ON_DETAIL</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">lena.dbcplogOnDetail</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">If true, log Validation query, Borrow/Return Connection (does not work if DBCPLOG_ON is false)</p></td>

</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">DBCPLOG_ON_STACKTRACE</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">lena.dbcplogOnStacktrace</p></td>
