</div>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_change_manager_language_setting"><a class="link" href="#_change_manager_language_setting">10.11. Change Manager Language Setting</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>You can change the language setting of LENA Manager.</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<caption class="title">Table 188. LENA Manager available languages</caption>
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 50%;">
<col style="width: 50%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-center valign-top">Language</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-center valign-top">Default</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">English (US)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-center valign-top"><p class="tableblock">O</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Korean (KR)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_how_to_change_language_setting"><a class="link" href="#_how_to_change_language_setting">10.11.1. How to Change Language Setting</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>To enable language setting changes, first navigate to:</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>ADMIN > Preference > Manager Environment<br>
(based on default English setting)</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Click the gear button under Manager Configuration to open the details and modify as follows.</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="ruby">...
 <span class="integer">9</span> <span class="comment"># i18n On/off</span>
<span class="integer">10</span> lena.i18n.enable=<span class="predefined-constant">true</span> <span class="comment"># false -> true</span>
...</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Now you can change the language on the Login page. If you are logged in, log out to go to the Login page.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="image"><img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/appendix_manager_lang_setting.png" alt="image" width="623" height="471"></span></p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>After selecting the language and logging in, you can use LENA Manager in the changed language.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="image"><img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/appendix_manager_lang_setting_example.png" alt="image" width="623" height="471"></span></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect2">
<h3 id="_session_server_details"><a class="link" href="#_session_server_details">10.12. Session Server Details</a></h3>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Application Server session clustering shares sessions by installing a separate Session Server.
The Session Server has a Standalone mode that runs on a separate VM and an Embedded mode where the Session Server module is embedded in the Application Server.</p>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_session_server_standalone_mode"><a class="link" href="#_session_server_standalone_mode">10.12.1. Session Server Standalone Mode</a></h4>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/appendix_session_standalone.png" alt="image" width="507" height="404">
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_installation"><a class="link" href="#_installation">Installation</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>For installation, refer to <a href="#session_install">Install</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_startstop_and_status_check"><a class="link" href="#_startstop_and_status_check">Start/Stop and Status Check</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>For start/stop and status checks, see <a href="#session_startstop">Start/Stop</a>.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_configuration"><a class="link" href="#_configuration">Configuration</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The location where the Session Server is installed is referred to as ${ZODIAC_HOME}. The Session Server is located under the LENA home /servers folder.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Configuration information is managed in ${ZODIAC_HOME}/session.conf. The configuration items that can be changed are as follows.</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 75%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Item</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">server_id</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">server ID</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">server_name</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">server Name</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">primary_port</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">TCP listening port of the Session Server</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">session_max_count</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Maximum number of HTTP sessions</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">server_recv_queue_size</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Queue size for processing requests for session information (update to latest/new registration, logout) received from the Secondary Server or Application Server</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">server_req_queue_size</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Queue size that holds requests for session information received from other servers (session info requests, latest info checks, etc.)</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">resp_queue_size</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Queue size that holds responses to session information requested by other servers</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">send_queue_size</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Queue size that holds session information to be sent to other servers</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">keep_alive_time</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Interval at which dummy messages are sent to maintain the TCP connection between Application Server and Session Server. Must be less than so_timeout. It is recommended to match each Application Server setting.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">so_timeout</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">read timeout in the connection with Application Server</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">thread_request_handler</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Number of threads that process data accumulated in the request Queue.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">thread_data_handler</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Number of threads that process data accumulated in the receive Queue.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">debug_clustering</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Whether to leave debug logs</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">enable_auto_was_sync</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">When set to true, sends a Sync request to the reconnected WAS (due to failure, etc.) to sync the WAS session data.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">enable_auto_peer_sync</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Whether to send a Sync request to the reconnected Secondary Session Server (due to failure, etc.) to sync the Slave Session Server’s session data</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">server_expire_sec</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Time to expire HTTP session information on the server (Session Timeout)</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If 0, use the session timeout set by the Application</p>
</div></div></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">server_expire_check_sec</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Session Timeout check interval (seconds)</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">secondary_host</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Address of the Secondary session server</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">secondary_port</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Address of the Secondary session server</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">enable_ready_after_sync</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Whether to send the Ready state (available to provide clustering service) to connected WAS after performing session data synchronization with the Secondary Server (true sends Ready after synchronization)</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">wait_server_ready_timeout</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">If the Ready state (available to provide Session Clustering service) is not reached by this time, it will automatically be set to Ready.</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">server_ready_time</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Wait time to connect to the Secondary Server at startup (this value * 100 ms).</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">max_logoutset</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Maximum number of logged-out HTTP sessions</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">enable_auto_logout_sync</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">If true, sync logout information together when syncing session entry information (needed for round-robin when not sticky)</p></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_logs"><a class="link" href="#_logs">Logs</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Logs are stored at ${LENA_HOME}/logs/session-server/lena-[Session Server Name]_[YYYYMMDD].log. You can also check logs by running the ${ZODIAC_HOME}/log.sh file.</p>
</div>

<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_console"><a class="link" href="#_console">Console</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Zodiac Session Server provides APIs via JMX to query Session Server information and to execute Application Server sync commands. Run the console.sh file under ${ZODIAC_HOME} to use the Zodiac Session Server’s JMX features.</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash">[session_5002]$ ./console.sh

 =====zodiac session server JMX Console=====

 ------------------------------------------------------------

- Usage: ./console.sh <COMMAND> -
- <COMMAND> is one of the following: -
- 1. was_list -
- 2. status -
- 3. was_serverq -
- 4. was_sync -
- It needs WAS ID -
- example: ./console.sh was_sync <was id> -
- 5. search -
- It needs SESSION ID. -
- example: ./console.sh search <session id> -

 ------------------------------------------------------------</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The following are descriptions of console.sh commands.</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>Application Server List</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Shows the list of Application Servers connected to the current Session Server.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Run the shell command console.sh was_list.</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash">[session_5002]$ ./console.sh was_list

 =====zodiac session server JMX Console=====

RUN OPERATION: getServerInfo

RESULT:server={addr:/127.0.0.1:54001,name:wasEE7_29100,
info:{server_name=wasEE7_29100,pid=24915,hostname=solwas4,jvmName=bde0fbb29e8100285,context=/jpetstoreJTA;ROOT;/lena;/EPS;/HelloWorldWeb,type=INSTANCE}}server=
{addr:/127.0.0.1:33912,name:wasEE3_29100,
info:{server_name=wasEE3_29100,pid=10607,hostname=solmanager,jvmName=2b2451dd049f00285,context=/jpetstoreJDBC;ROOT;/jpetstore3,type=INSTANCE}}</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Session Server Status</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Shows the current Session Server status values.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Run the shell command console.sh status.</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash">[session_5002]$ ./console.sh status

 =====zodiac session server JMX Console=====

RUN OPERATION:

getStatusString{request_getfresh_logout:0,session_count:0,req_lost:0,request_
getfresh_not_new:0,request_getfresh_nodata:0,request_getnew_secondary:0,session_expired:0,request_getnew_logout:0,session_timeout:1800,request_getnew_nodata:0,session_max_count:2000000
,logout_from_nodes:0,pid:32705,session_recv_lost:0,logout_from_secondary:0,request_getfresh_secondary:0,request_getfresh:0,request_getnew:0,logout_count:0,data_from_nodes:0,resp_lost:0,request_getfresh_data:0,data_from_secondary:0}</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Session Server ServerQ Status</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Shows the ServerQ status of Zodiac Session Server. ServerQ is a module that manages connections of Application Servers connected to the Session Server. The data shown here are Queue information containing session data and request data sent by the Application Server.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Run the shell command console.sh was_serverq.</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash">[session_5002]$ ./console.sh was_serverq

=====zodiac session server JMX Console=====

PRINT ATTRIBUTEdataQ.size: 0requestQ.size: 0dataQ.overCnt:
0requestQ.overCnt: 0</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Session Id Search</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Shows the list of Application Servers that have a session matching the entered Session ID.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Run the shell command console.sh search [Session ID].</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash">[session_5002]$ ./console.sh search
B38E30BDE5223BAA0221B9479AF3DDAF.6ef7931859a200285
 =====zodiac session server JMX Console=====

RUN OPERATION: search

RESULT:{'AE4_29100'={lastAccessTime='2018-05-24
15:55:48.503',context='ROOT',attributeNames=[sessiontest.counter,
ARGO_DUPLICATION_STATUS],lastUpdateTime='2018-05-24
15:55:48.501',addr='/127.0.0.1:44568',id=B38E30BDE5223BAA0221B9479AF3DDAF.6ef7931859a200285,createTime='2018-05-24
15:55:43.241'}}</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>Application Server Session Sync</p>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Execute when syncing Application Server session information to the Session Server.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Run the shell command console.sh was_sync [Application Server jvmName (value printed as jvmName in was_list)].</p>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash">[session_5002]$ ./console.sh was_list

 =====zodiac session server JMX Console=====

RUN OPERATION: getServerInfo

RESULT:server={addr:/127.0.0.1:54001,name:wasEE7_29100,
info:{server_name=wasEE7_29100,pid=24915,hostname=solwas4,jvmName=bde0fbb29e8100285,context=/jpetstoreJTA;ROOT;/lena;/EPS;/HelloWorldWeb,type=INSTANCE}}server=
{addr:/127.0.0.1:33912,name:wasEE3_29100,
info:{server_name=wasEE3_29100,pid=10607,hostname=solmanager,jvmName=2b2451dd049f00285,context=/jpetstoreJDBC;ROOT;/jpetstore3,type=INSTANCE}}}</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
<div class="listingblock">
<div class="content">
<pre class="CodeRay highlight"><code data-lang="bash">[session_5002]$ ./console.sh was_sync bde0fbb29e8100285

 =====zodiac session server JMX Console=====

</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_session_server_failover"><a class="link" href="#_session_server_failover">Session Server failover</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The Session Server is configured as Primary/Secondary and synchronizes session information in real time. Since the Application Server maintains connections to both Primary/Secondary Session Servers, when a failure occurs in the Primary Session Server, failover to the Secondary Session Server occurs from the time the failure is detected.</p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/appendix_session_failover.png" alt="image" width="391" height="373">
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect3">
<h4 id="_session_server_embedded_mode"><a class="link" href="#_session_server_embedded_mode">10.12.2. Session Server Embedded Mode</a></h4>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>In Embedded mode, the Session Server module is embedded within the Application Server.</p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/appendix_session_embedemode.png" alt="image" width="391" height="373">
</div>
</div>
<div class="sect4">
<h5 id="_configuration_2"><a class="link" href="#_configuration_2">Configuration</a></h5>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>To configure the Session Server in Embedded mode, configure it from Manager’s Application Server settings screen,
or edit ${LENA_HOME}/servers/[ApplicationServerName]/conf/session.conf.</p>
</div>
<div class="imageblock">
<div class="content">
<img src="https://docs.lenalab.org/resources/1.3.4.2/static/images/manual/appendix_session_settings.png" alt="image" width="623" height="144">
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Descriptions of the items displayed on the screen are as follows.</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 50%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Item</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Note</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Session Server Mode</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Select Embedded or Client mode of Standalone Session Server</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Embedded Host</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Node name and server name of the Primary server in the Session Cluster</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Embedded Port</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Service port of the Primary server in the Session Cluster</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Secondary Server Host</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Node name and server name of the Secondary server in the Session Cluster</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Secondary Server Port</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Service port of the Secondary server in the Session Cluster</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Multi Login Control</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Whether to check multiple logins</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">false</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Logout Page when Multi Login check (Multi Login)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Logout result page shown to the user who logged in first in case of multiple logins</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Logout Message when Multi Login check (Multi Login)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Logout result message in case of multiple logins, provided to ajax client as JSON</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Expected Page When Multi Login Check (Multi Login)</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>In Manager, the configurable settings are predefined. By default, follow the default configuration.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Below are the configuration values that can be changed via the session.conf file.</p>
</div>
<table class="tableblock frame-all grid-all stretch">
<colgroup>
<col style="width: 25%;">
<col style="width: 50%;">
<col style="width: 25%;">
</colgroup>
<thead>
<tr>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Item</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Description</th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top">Default</th>
</tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">enable_clustering</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Whether to perform session clustering. If false, the session is not searched in the Session Server.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">TRUE</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">debug_clustering</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Whether to enable debug</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">FALSE</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">primary_host</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Address of the Primary Session Server</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>In Embedded mode, this is the Embedded Host value</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">127.0.0.1</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">primary_port</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Port of the Primary Session Server</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>In Embedded mode, this is the Embedded Port value</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">5005</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">secondary_host</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Address of the Secondary Session Server,<br>
Used only when the connection between the Application Server and the Primary Session Server is lost.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>In Embedded mode, this is the Slave Server Host value</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">127.0.0.1</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">secondary_port</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p>Port of the Secondary Session Server,<br>
Used only when the connection between the Application Server and the Primary Session Server is lost</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>In Embedded mode, this is the Slave Server Port value</p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">5006</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">recv_queue_size</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Queue size for processing requests for session information (update to latest/new registration, logout) received from other servers</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">512</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">req_queue_size</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Queue size that holds requests for session information (session info requests, latest info checks, etc.) received from other servers</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">512</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">resp_queue_size</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Queue size that holds responses to session information requested by other servers</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">512</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">send_queue_size</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Queue size that holds session information to be sent to other servers</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">512</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">keep_alive_time</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Interval at which dummy messages are sent to maintain the TCP connection between Application Server and Session Server. Must be less than so_timeout.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">3000</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">so_timeout</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">read timeout in the connection with Session Server</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">8000</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">tcp_open_try_interval</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Interval for retrying connection when connection to Session Server is lost</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">5000</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">find_timeout</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">When a transaction on the Application Server searches for a session, the time to wait for a server response. If the server does not respond within this time, the Application Server considers that the server does not have the session.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">500</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">wait_server_ready_cnt</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">If communication is connected to the Server but the Server state is not ready, wait up to the configured seconds. If -1, wait indefinitely.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">-1</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">server_embedded</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Whether to embed the session server module. If true, embed the session server module.</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">false</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">max_logoutset</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">Size of the set that stores logged-out HTTP sessions</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock">20000</p></td>
</tr>
<tr>
